Chapter 7. Job Scheduling Optimization作业调度优化

Chapter 7. Job Scheduling Optimization
作业调度优化

While model training encompasses the entire LLM lifecycle (from pre-training to alignment to customization), the previous chapter focused on model customization, the most common and practical approach for organizations working with LLMs. It introduced different customization techniques and frameworks, like Kubeflow Trainer, to implement distributed customization jobs on Kubernetes. In particular, a platform administrator must address a new set of operational challenges that go beyond the basic configuration of a training job.

模型训练涵盖 LLM 的整个生命周期（从预训练到对齐再到定制），上一章聚焦于模型定制——这是组织使用 LLM 时最常见、最实用的方式。它介绍了不同的定制技术与框架（如 Kubeflow Trainer），用于在 Kubernetes 上实现分布式定制作业。尤其是平台管理员，必须应对一系列超越训练作业基础配置的全新运维挑战。

While Chapter 3 focused mainly on inference production workloads, significant overlap exists regarding GPU management in Kubernetes. Moreover, even just looking at the management of long-running jobs on Kubernetes, model customization workloads differ significantly from traditional Kubernetes applications in several critical ways:

第 3 章主要关注推理生产负载，但在 Kubernetes 的 GPU 管理方面两者有大量重叠。此外，即使仅看 Kubernetes 上长时间运行作业的管理，模型定制负载也在几个关键方面与传统 Kubernetes 应用显著不同：

  • They are inherently resource intensive, requiring specialized hardware (GPUs) across multiple nodes for extended periods, sometimes days or even weeks.它们天生资源密集，需要跨多节点的专用硬件（GPU）并持续运行很长时间，有时数天甚至数周。
  • They exhibit strong interdependencies between components in a way that is not very common for Kubernetes workloads; for instance, all pods in a distributed training job must be scheduled together, using gang scheduling.它们的组件之间存在强依赖——这在 Kubernetes 负载中并不常见；例如分布式训练作业中的所有 Pod 必须一起调度，即使用 Gang Scheduling（族群调度）。
  • They generate an impressive amount of data to be shared across the network, making network performance a critical bottleneck.它们会产生惊人数量的数据需要跨网络共享，使网络性能成为关键瓶颈。
  • They represent a considerable cost, both in terms of time and resources, so that a reliable and efficient resource utilization is critical.它们在时间和资源上都是巨大开销，因此可靠且高效的资源利用率至关重要。
  • GPUs are scarce and expensive resources in most clusters, requiring sophisticated quota management and scheduling logic to prevent underutilization, while ensuring fair access across multiple teams and projects.在大多数集群中 GPU 是稀缺且昂贵的资源，需要复杂的配额管理与调度逻辑来防止利用率不足，同时确保多个团队和项目之间公平访问。

The combination of all of these defines the set of challenges that every Kubernetes platform administrator must address.

所有这些因素结合在一起，构成了每位 Kubernetes 平台管理员必须应对的一系列挑战。

This chapter explores these production-scale challenges by covering the essential optimizations and configurations required to operate a robust model customization platform on Kubernetes. We start with Kubernetes scheduler optimization strategies, including bin packing for cost-efficient GPU utilization and dynamic rescheduling through the descheduler to maintain optimization over time. We then explore gang scheduling solutions that ensure all components of a distributed training job are scheduled together, topology-aware scheduling that optimizes GPU interconnect placement, and quota management for fair resource allocation across teams. Additionally, we cover network optimizations that reduce communication bottlenecks, security considerations for multiuser environments, storage strategies for handling large datasets and model artifacts, and observability patterns that provide visibility into long-running training workloads.

本章探讨这些生产规模的挑战，覆盖在 Kubernetes 上运行健壮的模型定制平台所需的关键优化与配置。我们从 Kubernetes 调度器优化策略开始，包括用于成本高效 GPU 利用的装箱（bin packing），以及通过 descheduler 进行动态重调度以长期维持优化。随后探讨族群调度方案——确保分布式训练作业的所有组件被一起调度；拓扑感知调度——优化 GPU 互连布局；以及配额管理——实现跨团队的公平资源分配。此外还涵盖降低通信瓶颈的网络优化、多用户环境的安全考量、处理大数据集与模型制品的存储策略，以及提供长时间运行训练负载可见性的可观测性模式。

The goal is to take the principles that we learned from the previous chapter and make them part of a production-ready platform capable of supporting enterprise-scale model customization workflows while maintaining the operational standards expected in modern Kubernetes environments.

目标是把上一章学到的原则融入一个生产就绪的平台，使其能够支持企业级模型定制工作流，同时保持现代 Kubernetes 环境所期望的运维标准。

Note: Why we say "training job" throughout this chapter

Throughout this chapter, we use the term training job to refer to all forms of LLM model customization workloads, including fine-tuning and other techniques discussed in Chapter 6, because they share the same platform requirements: gang scheduling for distributed execution, high-performance networking for gradient synchronization, GPU resource management, and robust observability. While the data science techniques differ, the infrastructure challenges and operational patterns remain consistent across all model customization approaches for LLMs. The chapter is specific to LLM customization because traditional predictive models (classification, regression, and time-series forecasting) are typically much smaller and often train efficiently on single GPUs or CPUs, not requiring the specialized infrastructure described in this chapter.

本章通篇使用“训练作业”一词来指代所有形式的 LLM 模型定制负载，包括微调以及第 6 章讨论的其他技术，因为它们共享相同的平台需求：用于分布式执行的族群调度、用于梯度同步的高性能网络、GPU 资源管理以及健壮的可观测性。虽然数据科学技术各不相同，但在所有 LLM 模型定制方法中，基础设施挑战与运维模式是一致的。本章专门针对 LLM 定制，因为传统预测模型（分类、回归、时间序列预测）通常小得多，往往能在单 GPU 或 CPU 上高效训练，并不需要本章所述的专用基础设施。

Kubernetes Scheduler Optimization
Kubernetes 调度器优化

The Kubernetes scheduler provides a flexible, pluggable architecture that supports sophisticated configuration to optimize pod placement for different workload requirements. GPU training platforms can leverage this flexibility through strategies like bin packing to consolidate workloads and reduce costs, combined with dynamic rescheduling to maintain optimization as cluster state evolves. This section covers the core scheduling mechanics, bin packing strategies for cost efficiency, and the descheduler for continuous optimization.

Kubernetes 调度器提供灵活、可插拔的架构，支持复杂配置以针对不同负载需求优化 Pod 布局。GPU 训练平台可以利用这种灵活性，通过装箱等策略整合负载、降低成本，并结合动态重调度在集群状态演进时持续维持优化。本节介绍核心调度机制、面向成本效率的装箱策略，以及用于持续优化的 descheduler。

Core Kubernetes Scheduler

The Kubernetes scheduler operates through a two-phase decision process independently for each pod. First, the filtering phase (candidate selection) eliminates nodes that cannot satisfy the pod's requirements. This includes insufficient CPU, memory, GPU resources, or failing to meet taints, tolerations, and affinity rules (see "Node affinity" on page 88).

Kubernetes 调度器对每个 Pod 独立执行两阶段决策流程。第一阶段是过滤（候选选择），剔除无法满足 Pod 需求的节点——包括 CPU、内存、GPU 资源不足，或不满足污点、容忍与亲和性规则（参见第 88 页“节点亲和性”）。

The scoring phase (node ranking) happens next and ranks the remaining candidate nodes using weighted criteria such as resource balance, pod spreading, and affinity preferences to select the optimal placement. Once a node is selected, the scheduler performs the binding operation to assign the pod to that node. The binding operation concludes the scheduling phase, and the Kubelet running on that node takes over to start the container.

接下来是评分阶段（节点排序），它使用加权准则（如资源均衡、Pod 散布、亲和偏好）对剩余候选节点排序，选出最优布局。一旦选定节点，调度器执行绑定操作把 Pod 分配到该节点。绑定完成调度阶段后，运行在该节点上的 Kubelet 接管并启动容器。

The Kubelet, an agent that runs on each Kubernetes node, is responsible for the execution of the containers on that node according to the specifications provided by the control plane.

Kubelet 是运行在每个 Kubernetes 节点上的代理，负责按照控制平面提供的规范在该节点上执行容器。

See Figure 7-1 for more details.

Resource Bin Packing Strategy

While the default Kubernetes scheduler spreads pods across nodes to improve availability, GPU training platforms often benefit from the opposite approach: packing pods tightly onto fewer nodes to maximize utilization and enable cost-effective cluster autoscaling. This is particularly valuable for GPU clusters where nodes can cost $10–30 per hour, and consolidating workloads onto fully-utilized nodes creates "empty" nodes that autoscalers can safely drain and remove.

默认 Kubernetes 调度器把 Pod 散布到各节点以提高可用性，但 GPU 训练平台往往从相反做法中获益：把 Pod 紧密打包到更少节点上以最大化利用率，并实现成本高效的集群自动扩缩容。这在 GPU 集群中尤其有价值——节点每小时成本可达 10–30 美元——把负载整合到满负载节点后，会腾出“空”节点，自动扩缩器可以安全地排空并移除。

The resource bin packing strategy implements tight pod consolidation through the scheduler's NodeResourcesFit scoring plug-in. The MostAllocated strategy scores nodes higher when they already have greater resource allocation, favoring consolidation over the default LeastAllocated spreading behavior (see Example 7-1).

资源装箱策略通过调度器的 NodeResourcesFit 评分插件实现紧密的 Pod 整合。MostAllocated 策略在节点已分配资源更多时给更高评分，偏好整合而非默认的 LeastAllocated 散布行为（见例 7-1）。

原书第 246 页

Example 7-1. Scheduler configuration for bin packing

apiVersion: kubescheduler.config.k8s.io/v1
kind: KubeSchedulerConfiguration
profiles:
- schedulerName: binpack-scheduler
  pluginConfig:
  - name: NodeResourcesFit
    args:
      scoringStrategy:
        type: MostAllocated
        resources:
        - name: nvidia.com/gpu
          weight: 5
        - name: cpu
          weight: 1
        - name: memory
          weight: 1
  • 自定义调度器名称，训练作业通过引用它来启用装箱行为。
  • MostAllocated 策略：节点已分配资源越多评分越高，偏好整合。
  • GPU 资源权重更高（5），优先对 GPU 装箱而非 CPU/内存，反映 GPU 更高的成本与稀缺性。

Platform administrators must balance bin packing's cost efficiency against reduced availability because a single node failure will affect more training jobs, and resource contention can create CPU, memory, or network bottlenecks even when GPU resources are available. Bin packing particularly suits cost-sensitive batch training workloads that tolerate interruptions through checkpoint and resume workflows, while production training platforms often use multiple scheduler profiles to offer both bin packing for experimental jobs and spreading for critical workloads requiring resilience.

平台管理员必须在装箱的成本效率与可用性下降之间权衡——单节点故障会影响更多训练作业；即使 GPU 资源可用，资源争用也可能造成 CPU、内存或网络瓶颈。装箱特别适合对成本敏感、能通过检查点与恢复工作流容忍中断的批训练负载；而生产训练平台通常使用多个调度器 profile，既为实验作业提供装箱，也为需要韧性的关键负载提供散布。

Dynamic Scheduling with Descheduler

The bin packing strategy described earlier optimizes initial pod placement, but over time these optimizations degrade as workloads terminate and new jobs arrive at different rates across nodes. The Kubernetes descheduler, available as a separate installation, addresses this dynamic optimization challenge by continuously evaluating pod placement and evicting pods from suboptimally placed locations so the scheduler can reschedule them according to current cluster state and policies. Unlike the scheduler, which reacts to new pod creation events, the descheduler proactively identifies existing pods that violate placement policies or contribute to resource fragmentation, then evicts them to trigger rescheduling that improves overall cluster efficiency.

前面描述的装箱策略优化的是初始 Pod 布局，但随时间推移，当负载终止、新作业以不同速率到达各节点时，这些优化会退化。Kubernetes descheduler（需单独安装）通过持续评估 Pod 布局、从次优位置驱逐 Pod，让调度器按当前集群状态与策略重新调度，从而应对这一动态优化挑战。与响应新 Pod 创建事件的调度器不同，descheduler 主动识别违反布局策略或加剧资源碎片的现有 Pod，驱逐它们以触发重调度，提升整体集群效率。

The descheduler operates as a separate component (typically deployed as a CronJob for periodic optimization or a deployment for continuous monitoring) that applies configurable strategy plug-ins, defined through a DeschedulerPolicy custom resource, to identify pods for eviction. When the descheduler evicts a pod, it simply deletes the pod. The pod's controller (ReplicaSet, StatefulSet, or in the case of training jobs, the Kubeflow Trainer) immediately recreates the pod, and the scheduler then places it according to current scheduling policies and cluster state. This eviction-and-reschedule cycle respects PodDisruptionBudgets (PDBs), ensuring that the descheduler never violates availability constraints or disrupts critical workloads beyond configured tolerances, making PDBs the primary mechanism for protecting gang-scheduled training jobs from premature eviction (Example 7-2).

descheduler 作为独立组件运行（通常部署为 CronJob 做周期性优化，或部署为 Deployment 做持续监控），通过 DeschedulerPolicy 自定义资源定义可配置的策略插件来识别待驱逐的 Pod。descheduler 驱逐 Pod 时只是删除它；Pod 的控制器（ReplicaSet、StatefulSet，训练作业场景下是 Kubeflow Trainer）立即重建 Pod，调度器再按当前策略与集群状态放置它。这一驱逐-重调度循环遵守 PodDisruptionBudget（PDB），确保 descheduler 不会违反可用性约束、也不会超出配置容忍度扰乱关键负载——PDB 因此成为保护族群调度训练作业不被过早驱逐的主要机制（例 7-2）。

Example 7-2. PodDisruptionBudget protecting gang-scheduled training job

apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: llm-training-pdb
spec:
  # Ensures all workers remain running simultaneously (gang scheduling requirement)
  minAvailable: 4
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      # All pods belonging to the same training job
      scheduling.x-k8s.io/pod-group: llm-training-group

Several descheduler strategies address different optimization goals for GPU training platforms. These strategies are configured in the profiles[].plugins section of the DeschedulerPolicy resource (see Table 7-1).

有多种 descheduler 策略对应 GPU 训练平台不同的优化目标，它们在 DeschedulerPolicy 资源的 profiles[].plugins 段中配置（见表 7-1）。

The primary risk of descheduling is job disruption. Evicting pods from long-running LLM training jobs forces expensive checkpoint-and-resume cycles that can delay training completion by hours or days. Platform administrators mitigate this through deployment frequency (running descheduler infrequently during maintenance windows versus continuously for maximum efficiency), PodDisruptionBudgets (protecting critical jobs from eviction), and namespace segmentation (excluding production training namespaces while optimizing experimental ones). Organizations should validate that optimization benefits (reduced node costs from better bin packing) exceed disruption costs (training time lost to checkpointing).

descheduling 的主要风险是作业中断。从长时间运行的 LLM 训练作业中驱逐 Pod 会触发昂贵的检查点-恢复循环，可能让训练完成延迟数小时甚至数天。平台管理员通过以下方式缓解：部署频率（在维护窗口低频运行 descheduler，还是持续运行以最大化效率）、PodDisruptionBudget（保护关键作业不被驱逐）、命名空间隔离（优化实验命名空间时排除生产训练命名空间）。组织应验证优化收益（更好装箱带来的节点成本下降）是否超过中断成本（检查点损失的训练时间）。

Important: Keep descheduler strategies aligned with the scheduler

The descheduler's strategies must align with the scheduler's placement policies, or the system enters an eviction loop where the descheduler evicts pods that the scheduler immediately places back on the same node, only to be evicted again:

  • If using HighNodeUtilization in the descheduler, the scheduler must use the MostAllocated (bin packing) strategy.
  • If using LowNodeUtilization in the descheduler, the scheduler must use the LeastAllocated (spreading) strategy.
  • Never enable both HighNodeUtilization and LowNodeUtilization simultaneously. They have opposing goals and will conflict.

Verify alignment through monitoring: if eviction count increases continuously without node consolidation progress, an eviction loop likely exists, requiring policy correction.

descheduler 的策略必须与调度器的布局策略对齐，否则系统会陷入驱逐循环——descheduler 驱逐 Pod，调度器立刻又把它放回同一节点，然后再次被驱逐：
  • 若 descheduler 用 HighNodeUtilization，调度器必须用 MostAllocated（装箱）策略。
  • 若 descheduler 用 LowNodeUtilization，调度器必须用 LeastAllocated（散布）策略。
  • 切勿同时启用 HighNodeUtilization 与 LowNodeUtilization，两者目标相反会冲突。
通过监控验证对齐：若驱逐计数持续上升却没有节点整合进展，很可能存在驱逐循环，需要修正策略。

Gang Scheduling
族群调度

The scheduler optimizations covered previously (bin packing for cost efficiency and descheduler for dynamic re-optimization) address how individual pods are placed and maintained on nodes. However, distributed training jobs introduce a fundamentally different challenge: ensuring that all components of a multipod job are scheduled together as an atomic unit. The default per-pod scheduling model works efficiently for containerized applications and microservices, but it fundamentally breaks down for distributed training jobs where the scheduler has no awareness that multiple pods belong to a single coordinated workload. Each pod schedules independently. For instance, the scheduler may successfully place seven out of eight workers, tying up GPU assigned resources while the job deadlocks waiting for the missing worker that cannot be scheduled due to resource exhaustion; this is also called resource fragmentation.

前面讨论的调度器优化（面向成本效率的装箱、面向动态再优化的 descheduler）解决的是单个 Pod 如何在节点上放置与维持。但分布式训练作业带来根本不同的挑战：必须确保多 Pod 作业的所有组件作为一个原子单元一起调度。默认的逐 Pod 调度模型对容器化应用和微服务很高效，但对分布式训练作业会彻底失效——调度器并不知道多个 Pod 属于同一个协同负载，每个 Pod 独立调度。例如调度器可能成功放下 8 个 worker 中的 7 个，占用已分配的 GPU 资源，而作业却在死锁等待那个因资源耗尽无法调度的缺失 worker；这也叫资源碎片。

Large-scale LLM training jobs require an all-or-nothing approach for scheduling because frameworks like PyTorch use a rendezvous mechanism where all workers must discover each other and synchronize at a barrier before training can begin. Similarly, DeepSpeed and other frameworks establish communication barriers during each training iteration to coordinate gradient synchronization. If even a single worker is missing, the rendezvous barrier cannot complete, causing the entire job to deadlock while consuming GPU resources on already-scheduled workers. A cluster is designed to handle multiple concurrent users who simultaneously submit their training jobs with the expectation of a fair scheduling policy that guarantees the execution within a certain time/SLO.

大规模 LLM 训练作业需要“全有或全无”的调度方式，因为 PyTorch 等框架使用 rendezvous（会合）机制：所有 worker 必须互相发现并在屏障处同步后才能开始训练。类似地，DeepSpeed 等框架在每次训练迭代中建立通信屏障以协调梯度同步。只要缺一个 worker，会合屏障就无法完成，整个作业死锁，而已调度 worker 上的 GPU 资源仍被占用。集群被设计为同时服务多个并发用户，他们同时提交训练作业，期望有公平的调度策略保证在一定时间/SLO 内执行。

原书第 250 页

Gang scheduling, also known as coscheduling, is a scheduling strategy that ensures all pods belonging to the same distributed job are scheduled together as a single atomic unit. Either all pods are scheduled simultaneously or none are. This scheduling technique uses a queue where the pods remain in a pending state without assigning resources until the scheduler can guarantee that sufficient resources exist across the cluster to satisfy the complete job requirement.

族群调度（也称协同调度）是一种调度策略，确保同一分布式作业的所有 Pod 作为单个原子单元一起调度——要么全部同时调度，要么一个都不调度。这种技术使用一个队列，Pod 保持 pending 状态、不分配资源，直到调度器能保证集群中有足够资源满足整个作业需求。

The gang scheduling problem is not new to Kubernetes or specific for distributed training jobs, but it affects them more because of GPU scarcity and cost. Kubernetes has been designed to be pluggable, and different projects can be used to address this challenge.

族群调度问题对 Kubernetes 并不新鲜，也并非分布式训练作业独有，但由于 GPU 的稀缺与高成本，它对训练作业影响更大。Kubernetes 被设计为可插拔的，可以用不同项目来应对这一挑战。

PyTorch Rendezvous and Gang Scheduling

PyTorch's distributed training relies on a rendezvous mechanism that combines peer discovery with barrier synchronization. When a distributed training job starts, all workers connect to a rendezvous backend (typically a TCP-based key-value store or etcd) to:

PyTorch 分布式训练依赖会合机制，结合了对等发现与屏障同步。当分布式训练作业启动时，所有 worker 连接到会合后端（通常是基于 TCP 的 KV 存储或 etcd）以：

  1. Discover all other workers in the training job发现训练作业中的所有其他 worker
  2. Agree on the complete set of participants and assign ranks (0 to world_size-1)就完整参与者集合达成一致并分配 rank（0 到 world_size-1）
  3. Synchronize at a barrier—no worker proceeds until all workers arrive在屏障处同步——所有 worker 到达前任何 worker 都不继续
  4. Exchange connection information for peer-to-peer communication交换连接信息以进行对等通信

This rendezvous barrier is atomic and blocking: if the scheduler places seven out of eight workers but the eighth cannot be scheduled due to resource fragmentation, the seven scheduled workers will wait indefinitely at the rendezvous barrier. Those seven GPUs remain allocated but idle, consuming cost while producing no training progress.

这个会合屏障是原子且阻塞的：若调度器放下 8 个 worker 中的 7 个、第 8 个因资源碎片无法调度，这 7 个已调度 worker 会在会合屏障处无限等待。这 7 块 GPU 保持已分配却空闲，消耗成本却毫无训练进展。

Gang scheduling solves this by ensuring all eight workers schedule simultaneously or none schedule at all, preventing partial deployments that deadlock at rendezvous. While PyTorch's elastic training (torch.distributed.elastic) can handle dynamic worker sets, most LLM training uses static configurations where the worker count is fixed and all must be present.

族群调度通过确保 8 个 worker 全部同时调度或全部不调度来解决这一问题，避免在会合处死锁的部分部署。虽然 PyTorch 的弹性训练（torch.distributed.elastic）能处理动态 worker 集合，但大多数 LLM 训练使用静态配置——worker 数固定且必须全部到场。

Comparing Gang Scheduling Solutions

Several approaches exist for implementing gang scheduling on Kubernetes, each operating at different layers of the stack and serving different use cases. Table 7-2 describes the main options. Understanding the distinctions between these solutions helps platform administrators select the appropriate technology for their training workloads.

在 Kubernetes 上实现族群调度有多种方案，每种运行在技术栈的不同层、服务于不同用例。表 7-2 描述了主要选项。理解这些方案的差异有助于平台管理员为训练负载选择合适的技术。

The Kubernetes community is working on native gang scheduling support through KEP-4671. This proposal introduces a new core Workload type that enables all-or-nothing scheduling semantics directly in the Kubernetes scheduler, allowing pods to be scheduled together as a group. The enhancement aims to provide a standard scheduling framework for tightly coupled workloads like distributed training jobs, where all workers must start simultaneously to avoid deadlocks at framework synchronization points. Once the KEP is approved and implemented, alternative schedulers like Volcano and KAI Scheduler will need to update their implementations to support the standardized Workload API for compatibility with the broader Kubernetes ecosystem. While currently in the proposal stage, this native support would eliminate the need for external plug-ins or custom schedulers for basic gang scheduling use cases, though the solutions described earlier remain valuable for production deployments today and offer additional features like advanced queue management and GPU-specific optimizations.

Kubernetes 社区正通过 KEP-4671 推进原生族群调度支持。该提案引入新的核心 Workload 类型，在 Kubernetes 调度器中直接启用“全有或全无”调度语义，让 Pod 作为一组被一起调度。该增强旨在为紧耦合负载（如分布式训练作业——所有 worker 必须同时启动以避免在框架同步点死锁）提供标准调度框架。一旦 KEP 获批并实现，Volcano、KAI Scheduler 等替代调度器需要更新实现以支持标准化 Workload API，从而与更广泛的 Kubernetes 生态兼容。虽然目前仍处于提案阶段，这种原生支持将使基本族群调度用例不再需要外部插件或自定义调度器；不过前述方案在当下的生产部署中仍然有价值，并提供高级队列管理、GPU 专用优化等额外特性。

Coscheduling plug-in (PodGroup CRD)

The coscheduling plug-in provides the most direct path to gang scheduling for existing Kubernetes clusters, extending the default scheduler without requiring a full replacement.

coscheduling 插件为现有 Kubernetes 集群提供了最直接的族群调度路径——扩展默认调度器，无需完全替换。

The installation requires the platform administrator to install the scheduler-plug-ins package and enable the coscheduling plug-in in the kube-scheduler configuration. After installation, it is necessary to define a PodGroup object that represents the scheduling unit and, finally, label all pods that are part of the same training job with the scheduling.x-k8s.io/pod-group: groupId annotation to make them managed as single scheduling units (see Example 7-3). This approach preserves existing scheduler behavior for nongang-scheduled workloads while adding coscheduling capabilities only where needed, making the adoption easier and limiting the impact on a production cluster.

安装时，平台管理员需安装 scheduler-plug-ins 包并在 kube-scheduler 配置中启用 coscheduling 插件。安装后需要定义一个代表调度单元的 PodGroup 对象，最后给同一训练作业中的所有 Pod 打上 scheduling.x-k8s.io/pod-group: groupId 标签，使它们作为单个调度单元被管理（见例 7-3）。这种方式为非族群调度负载保留现有调度器行为，只在需要处增加协同调度能力，从而易于采用并限制对生产集群的影响。

原书第 252 页

The PodGroup CRD provides a very simple abstraction to group different deployments, but it remains a low-level abstraction; for example, it is not possible to manage job-level quotas, prioritization, or any other advanced scheduling policy.

PodGroup CRD 提供了一个非常简单的抽象来把不同 deployment 分组，但它仍是底层抽象；例如无法管理作业级配额、优先级或任何其他高级调度策略。

Example 7-3. PodGroup configuration

apiVersion: scheduling.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1
kind: PodGroup
metadata:
  name: llm-training-group
spec:
  minMember: 4
  scheduleTimeoutSeconds: 300

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: llm-training-0
  labels:
    scheduling.x-k8s.io/pod-group: llm-training-group
    job-role: leader
spec:
  ...
  • 调度器必须一起调度的最小 Pod 数。分布式训练作业通常有 driver 和 worker，此配置需把两者都算进去。由于每个 Pod 独立创建，此值告诉调度器该组的预期最小规模。
  • 等待所有 Pod 变为可调度状态的最长时间。
  • 第一个工作负载 Pod；其他 Pod 按相同模式并匹配 pod-group 标签。
  • 所有具有相同 pod-group 标签值的 Pod 被视为单个原子调度单元，同时保留各自独立的 deployment 规范。
  • job-role 标签并非 PodGroup 设计的一部分，但用它说明每个 Pod 的角色是最佳实践。
原书第 253 页

Kueue

The Kueue project operates at a higher abstraction layer than scheduler plug-ins, providing job-level admission control that decides whether the cluster should admit workloads based on available quota and queue priority. When Kueue admits a job, it ensures that all required resources exist and complements low-level gang scheduling mechanisms that guarantee atomic scheduling.

Kueue 项目运行在比调度器插件更高的抽象层，提供作业级准入控制——根据可用配额与队列优先级决定集群是否接纳负载。当 Kueue 接纳一个作业时，它确保所有所需资源存在，并补充底层保证原子调度的族群调度机制。

The biggest value of Kueue is the ability to handle multitenant resource management: it implements hierarchical resource quotas, priority-based queuing, resource borrowing between teams, and fairness policies that prevent any single tenant from monopolizing cluster resources. A platform administrator should consider Kueue when managing shared training clusters across multiple teams, as it provides a policy layer (who gets resources and when) that enables a more generic GPU as a Service use case, covered in "Quota Management and Multitenancy: GPU as a Service" on page 229.

Kueue 最大的价值在于多租户资源管理能力：它实现分层资源配额、基于优先级的排队、团队间资源借用，以及防止单一租户独占集群资源的公平策略。当跨多个团队管理共享训练集群时，平台管理员应考虑 Kueue——它提供策略层（谁在何时获得资源），支持更通用的 GPU 即服务用例，见第 229 页“配额管理与多租户：GPU 即服务”。

Finally, Kueue integrates seamlessly with Kubeflow Trainer, RayJob, and other AI projects, making it a natural choice to implement training job orchestration. The end-to-end flow with Kueue includes different personas: the platform administrator configures global rules in ClusterQueue and creates the LocalQueue that the Data Scientist can use to access the assigned quota and provision the workload (see Figure 7-2).

最后，Kueue 与 Kubeflow Trainer、RayJob 及其他 AI 项目无缝集成，是实现训练作业编排的自然选择。Kueue 的端到端流程涉及不同角色：平台管理员在 ClusterQueue 中配置全局规则并创建 LocalQueue，数据科学家用它访问分配的配额并提交负载（见图 7-2）。

When you submit a job with Kueue integration (using the kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name label), Kueue automatically creates a custom resource of type Workload to manage admission control. This Workload object is separate from your actual job (TrainJob, Job, etc.) and tracks the resource requirements and admission status. To check the status after submission:

当你提交带 Kueue 集成的作业（使用 kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name 标签）时，Kueue 自动创建类型为 Workload 的自定义资源来管理准入控制。这个 Workload 对象独立于你的实际作业（TrainJob、Job 等），跟踪资源需求与准入状态。提交后检查状态：

  1. Check the Workload object: kubectl get workloads -n shows whether your job is admitted or queued.检查 Workload 对象：kubectl get workloads -n 显示作业已被接纳还是在排队。
  2. Check the actual job: kubectl get trainjob -n shows the job status, but it will remain suspended until Kueue admits it.检查实际作业：kubectl get trainjob -n 显示作业状态，但在 Kueue 接纳前它会保持 suspended。
  3. Understand the flow: job submitted → Kueue creates Workload → Workload queued → quota available → Workload admitted → job unsuspended → pods created.理解流程：作业提交 → Kueue 创建 Workload → Workload 排队 → 配额可用 → Workload 被接纳 → 作业解除挂起 → Pod 创建。
原书第 254 页

The Workload object status conditions will show messages like "QuotaReserved" when admitted or "InsufficientQuota" when queued, helping you understand why a job isn't running yet (see Example 7-4).

Workload 对象的 status.conditions 会显示类似 QuotaReserved（已接纳）或 InsufficientQuota（排队中）的消息，帮助你理解作业为何还没运行（见例 7-4）。

Example 7-4. Status of a Kueue Workload object

status:
  conditions:
  - type: Admitted
    status: "True"
    reason: "QuotaReserved"
    message: "The workload is admitted and quota is reserved"
  admission:
    clusterQueue: "ai-training-cluster-queue"
    podSetAssignments:
    - count: 1
      flavors:
        nvidia.com/gpu: gpu-training-flavor
      name: head
    - count: 1
      flavors:
        nvidia.com/gpu: gpu-training-flavor
      name: worker

NVIDIA KAI Scheduler

NVIDIA KAI Scheduler is the open source version of the core scheduling engine developed by run:ai (acquired by NVIDIA). It works only with NVIDIA hardware, and it has a different approach because it centralizes management by focusing on GPU-aware optimizations including fractional allocation, time slicing, and hierarchical queue management with fairness policies. These optimizations are then combined with gang scheduling integrated with GPU topology-aware placement (NVLink connectivity) to co-locate distributed training jobs.

NVIDIA KAI Scheduler 是 run:ai（被 NVIDIA 收购）开发的核心调度引擎的开源版本。它仅适用于 NVIDIA 硬件，方式也不同——它集中化管理，专注于 GPU 感知优化，包括 fractional 分配、时间分片，以及带公平策略的分层队列管理。这些优化再与族群调度结合，并集成 GPU 拓扑感知布局（NVLink 连通性），把分布式训练作业放在一起。

KAI Scheduler supports gang scheduling and usually performs it via explicit integration with some aggregated deployment API (see "Kubeflow Trainer" on page 192), rather than by aggregating independent pods. It is an alternative Kubernetes scheduler with the main goal of minimizing idle GPU costs with built-in Kubeflow integration. Example 7-5 shows the configuration using a PyTorchJob resource; when using TrainJob, these settings (annotations and schedulerName) are configured in the ClusterTrainingRuntime template.

KAI Scheduler 支持族群调度，通常通过与某个聚合部署 API（见第 192 页“Kubeflow Trainer”）显式集成来实现，而非聚合独立 Pod。它是一个替代 Kubernetes 调度器，主要目标是通过内建 Kubeflow 集成最小化空闲 GPU 成本。例 7-5 展示使用 PyTorchJob 资源的配置；使用 TrainJob 时，这些设置（注解与 schedulerName）在 ClusterTrainingRuntime 模板中配置。

Example 7-5. KAI Scheduler usage with gang scheduling (PyTorchJob)

# project with GPU quota
apiVersion: kai.run.ai/v1
kind: Project
metadata:
  name: ml-team-a
spec:
  gpuQuota: 8

---
# Distributed training job with gang scheduling
apiVersion: kubeflow.org/v1
kind: PyTorchJob
metadata:
  name: llm-training
  namespace: ml-team-a
  annotations:
    kai.run.ai/project: ml-team-a
spec:
  pytorchReplicaSpecs:
    master:
      replicas: 1
      template:
        spec:
          schedulerName: kai-scheduler
  ...
  • 项目级 GPU 配额（共 8 块 GPU），用于公平共享调度。
  • 注解把作业与上面定义的项目绑定，用于配额记账。
  • 必须在 spec 中使用 kai-scheduler，由它提供 GPU 感知布局与族群调度。
原书第 256 页

Note: PyTorchJob resources vs. TrainJob

The examples in this chapter use PyTorchJob resources from the Kubeflow Training Operator (kubeflow.org/v1 API) to demonstrate scheduling and network configurations at the Kubernetes resource level. While the previous chapter introduced Kubeflow Trainer's higher-level TrainJob abstraction (trainer.kubeflow.org/v1alpha1 API), the scheduling concepts shown here apply equally to both approaches. TrainJob resources create JobSet workloads internally, and scheduling configurations such as scheduler selection, Kueue labels, network annotations, and NCCL environment variables are specified in the ClusterTrainingRuntime or TrainingRuntime templates. This separation allows platform administrators to configure these production optimizations in runtime templates while data scientists focus on training logic through the SDK.

本章示例使用 Kubeflow Training Operator 的 PyTorchJob 资源（kubeflow.org/v1 API），在 Kubernetes 资源层面演示调度与网络配置。上一章介绍了 Kubeflow Trainer 更高层的 TrainJob 抽象（trainer.kubeflow.org/v1alpha1 API），但这里展示的调度概念对两者同样适用。TrainJob 资源内部创建 JobSet 负载，调度选择、Kueue 标签、网络注解、NCCL 环境变量等调度配置在 ClusterTrainingRuntime 或 TrainingRuntime 模板中指定。这种分离让平台管理员在运行时模板中配置这些生产优化，而数据科学家通过 SDK 专注训练逻辑。

Volcano

The Volcano project is a CNCF sandbox project originally created by Huawei. It provides a comprehensive batch scheduling system for HPC, AI/ML, and big data workloads (i.e., Apache Spark) that entirely replaces the kube-scheduler with a monolithic solution. This solution integrates queue management, gang scheduling, and topology-aware placement.

Volcano 项目是 CNCF 沙箱项目，最初由华为创建。它为 HPC、AI/ML 和大数据负载（如 Apache Spark）提供全面的批调度系统，用一个单体方案完全替换 kube-scheduler。该方案集成了队列管理、族群调度与拓扑感知布局。

Volcano introduces Queue, PodGroup, and Job CRDs to describe and handle advanced scheduling algorithms, and reclaim policies for preemption of lower-priority jobs, making it suitable for production environments running complex batch workflows covering all major frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Apache Spark. However, adopting Volcano requires replacing the default Kubernetes scheduler entirely, making it more invasive than layering Kueue over kube-scheduler with the coscheduling plug-in; thus it may not be applicable to existing production clusters where existing traditional workloads are present.

Volcano 引入 Queue、PodGroup、Job CRD 来描述和处理高级调度算法，以及用于抢占低优先级作业的回收策略，适合运行覆盖 TensorFlow、PyTorch、Apache Spark 等主流框架的复杂批工作流的生产环境。但采用 Volcano 需要完全替换默认 Kubernetes 调度器，比在 kube-scheduler 上叠加 Kueue 加 coscheduling 插件更具侵入性；因此它可能不适用于已有传统负载的现有生产集群。

原书第 257 页

Making the right choice

In this section, we introduced different techniques to achieve gang scheduling on Kubernetes for distributed training jobs, along with their pros and cons. However, in a real-world production cluster, it is very common to combine different solutions.

本节介绍了在 Kubernetes 上为分布式训练作业实现族群调度的不同技术及其优缺点。但在真实生产集群中，组合不同方案非常常见。

A common (and recommended) scenario is the combination of Kueue for admission control and quota management, together with AI specialized deployment APIs like PyTorchJob (see "Kubeflow Trainer" on page 192) or LeaderWorkerSet. For example, the NVIDIA KAI Scheduler can replace the default scheduler to provide GPU-aware optimizations while still leveraging the admission management provided by the Kueue layer.

一个常见（且推荐）的场景是：用 Kueue 做准入控制与配额管理，结合 PyTorchJob（见第 192 页“Kubeflow Trainer”）或 LeaderWorkerSet 等 AI 专用部署 API。例如 NVIDIA KAI Scheduler 可替换默认调度器以提供 GPU 感知优化，同时仍利用 Kueue 层提供的准入管理。

Note: LeaderWorkerSet (LWS)

The LeaderWorkerSet (LWS) project can be used together with specialized schedulers because it addresses a different problem: managing workloads with inherent leader-worker topology rather than just ensuring atomic scheduling. While LWS assumes gang scheduling semantics (all pods in a group are scheduled together or not at all), its primary value is providing a workload API that understands the leader-worker pattern common in AI/ML inference scenarios, where a leader pod coordinates work distribution to worker pods and both must be co-located or networked efficiently. This makes LWS specialized for AI/ML as compared, for example, to the more generic PodGroup API. While PyTorchJob is specialized for distributed training jobs, the main goal of LWS is distributed inference, especially multihost inference workloads where the LLM will be sharded and run across multiple devices on multiple nodes. This scenario has the same gang scheduling challenge as a distributed training job.

LeaderWorkerSet（LWS）项目可与专用调度器一起使用，因为它解决的是另一个问题：管理具有固有 leader-worker 拓扑的负载，而不仅仅是保证原子调度。虽然 LWS 假定族群调度语义（组内所有 Pod 一起调度或都不调度），但其主要价值是提供理解 AI/ML 推理场景中常见 leader-worker 模式的负载 API——leader Pod 协调向 worker Pod 分发工作，两者必须同处或高效联网。这使 LWS 相比更通用的 PodGroup API 更专用于 AI/ML。PyTorchJob 专用于分布式训练作业，而 LWS 的主要目标是分布式推理，尤其是 LLM 被分片运行在多节点多设备上的多主机推理负载。这种场景与分布式训练作业面临相同的族群调度挑战。

While the gang scheduling solutions discussed earlier ensure that distributed training jobs receive complete resource allocations, they don't address where those resources are located within the cluster's physical infrastructure. The placement of pods across nodes with different GPU interconnect technologies can dramatically impact training performance, making topology awareness the next critical scheduling consideration.

前述族群调度方案确保分布式训练作业获得完整资源分配，但它们不解决这些资源在集群物理基础设施中的位置。Pod 在具有不同 GPU 互连技术的节点间布局会显著影响训练性能，因此拓扑感知成为下一个关键调度考量。

Topology-Aware Scheduling
拓扑感知调度

While gang scheduling ensures that all pods in a distributed training job schedule together, it does not guarantee that those pods land on nodes with optimal hardware topology for inter-GPU communication.

族群调度确保分布式训练作业中的所有 Pod 一起调度，但它不保证这些 Pod 落在具有最优硬件拓扑、适合 GPU 间通信的节点上。

While a scheduler without gang scheduling might partially deploy a job (wasting expensive GPU resources), a scheduler without topology awareness risks spreading workers across different nodes. This imposes the use of unoptimized network connections for inter-GPU communication, forcing workers to use connections that are orders of magnitude slower and increasing job execution time dramatically.

没有族群调度的调度器可能部分部署作业（浪费昂贵 GPU 资源），而没有拓扑感知的调度器则可能把 worker 散布到不同节点。这会迫使 GPU 间通信使用未优化的网络连接，让 worker 使用慢几个数量级的连接，显著增加作业执行时间。

In this context, topology-aware refers to the physical interconnect architecture between GPUs. This includes whether GPUs are connected within a single node via NVLink or PCIe, across nodes through high-speed fabrics like InfiniBand or RoCE (RDMA over Converged Ethernet), or through standard Ethernet networking. The bandwidth and latency characteristics of these interconnects dramatically impact distributed training performance: NVLink provides up to 900 GBps bidirectional bandwidth between GPUs within the same node (with NVLink 4.0 on H100), InfiniBand offers 200–400 GBps across nodes with submicrosecond latency, while standard Ethernet typically delivers only 10–100 GBps with higher latency. The topic of bandwidth connecting different GPUs and the different technologies was discussed with similar concerns in the context of inference in "Single-Node Versus Multinode Inference" on page 110.

这里的“拓扑感知”指 GPU 之间的物理互连架构：GPU 是在单节点内通过 NVLink 或 PCIe 连接，还是跨节点通过 InfiniBand、RoCE（融合以太网上的 RDMA）等高速 fabric 连接，或通过标准以太网连接。这些互连的带宽与延迟特性对分布式训练性能影响巨大：NVLink 在同节点 GPU 间提供高达 900 GBps 双向带宽（H100 上 NVLink 4.0），InfiniBand 跨节点提供 200–400 GBps、亚微秒延迟，而标准以太网通常只有 10–100 GBps 且延迟更高。连接不同 GPU 的带宽与不同技术曾在第 110 页“单节点 vs 多节点推理”中以类似关切讨论过。

Sidebar: What is a fabric?

In networking terminology, a fabric refers to the underlying network infrastructure that provides interconnected communication paths between multiple nodes or devices. Unlike traditional hierarchical network architectures with discrete layers, a fabric provides a mesh-like topology where multiple paths exist between endpoints, enabling high bandwidth and low latency communication. In the context of GPU computing, fabrics like InfiniBand or NVSwitch (a switching fabric for full mesh GPU connectivity within a server) provide the high-speed interconnect infrastructure that enables GPUs to communicate efficiently. This can be either within a single server (NVSwitch fabric connecting 8–16 GPUs) or across multiple servers (InfiniBand fabric connecting hundreds of nodes). The fabric abstracts the complexity of the underlying switching infrastructure, presenting a unified high-performance communication layer to distributed training workloads.

在网络术语中，fabric 指为多节点或多设备之间提供互连通信路径的底层网络基础设施。与传统分层网络架构不同，fabric 提供网状拓扑，端点间存在多条路径，从而实现高带宽低延迟通信。在 GPU 计算语境下，InfiniBand 或 NVSwitch（服务器内全互联 GPU 连接的交换 fabric）等 fabric 提供让 GPU 高效通信的高速互连基础设施。它可以是单服务器内（NVSwitch fabric 连接 8–16 块 GPU）或跨多服务器（InfiniBand fabric 连接数百节点）。fabric 抽象了底层交换基础设施的复杂性，向分布式训练负载呈现统一的高性能通信层。
原书第 259 页

Topology-aware scheduling extends gang scheduling by considering hardware topology constraints when making placement decisions, ensuring that distributed training jobs are scheduled on nodes with the optimal interconnect configuration for their communication patterns.

拓扑感知调度在做布局决策时考虑硬件拓扑约束，扩展了族群调度，确保分布式训练作业被调度到具有与其通信模式最优互连配置的节点上。

A training job requiring eight GPUs might achieve significantly better performance when all eight GPUs reside within a single eight-GPU node connected via NVLink, as compared to spreading those GPUs across eight single-GPU nodes communicating over Ethernet. While all distributed training strategies benefit from high-quality interconnects, the degree of sensitivity varies significantly: Data Parallel training requires efficient gradient synchronization across workers, but Tensor Parallelism and Fully Sharded Data Parallelism (FSDP) impose particularly stringent requirements for low-latency, high-bandwidth interconnects because they perform fine-grained communication during every forward and backward pass. Activations must transfer between GPUs in tensor parallelism, and FSDP performs continuous parameter gathering and gradient reduction operations. All these operations scale with communication latency and inversely with bandwidth, making GPU topology and interconnect quality critical for training performance, especially for advanced parallelism strategies beyond simple data parallelism.

需要 8 块 GPU 的训练作业，若 8 块 GPU 都在单台 8 GPU 节点内通过 NVLink 连接，性能可能显著优于把它们散布到 8 台单 GPU 节点上用以太网通信。虽然所有分布式训练策略都受益于高质量互连，但敏感程度差异很大：数据并行需要 worker 间高效梯度同步，而张量并行与全分片数据并行（FSDP）对低延迟、高带宽互连要求尤其苛刻，因为它们在每次前向和反向传播中都做细粒度通信。张量并行需要在 GPU 间传输激活，FSDP 则持续做参数收集与梯度规约。所有这些操作都随通信延迟线性恶化、随带宽反向改善，使 GPU 拓扑与互连质量成为训练性能的关键——尤其是超越简单数据并行的高级并行策略。

Sidebar: Communication Patterns in Distributed Training

The main parallelism strategies generate distinct communication patterns with different network requirements. Data Parallelism training replicates the full model on each GPU and synchronizes gradients after every training step. Gradients represent the direction and magnitude of adjustments needed to improve the model's predictions: during each training iteration, the model makes predictions, compares them to the correct answers, and calculates how each model parameter (weight) should be adjusted to reduce prediction errors. Each worker computes gradients on its subset of training data, then all workers must synchronize their gradients (typically by averaging them) to ensure consistent model updates. With an LLM that has billions of parameters, every iteration might transfer tens of gigabytes of gradient data across all workers. Tensor Parallelism splits individual model layers across multiple GPUs, requiring activation transfers during both forward and backward passes. Activations are the intermediate computation results produced by each layer. For example, a single matrix multiplication might be split across four GPUs, with activation tensors passed between them during both forward and backward passes. This makes Tensor Parallelism particularly sensitive to network latency. FSDP is a memory-efficient alternative to Data Parallelism that shards (splits) model parameters, gradients, and optimizer states across all GPUs rather than replicating the full model. Each GPU gathers the necessary parameter shards from other GPUs "just-in-time" for computation, then discards them to minimize memory usage. This frequent all-gather and reduce-scatter communication makes FSDP particularly sensitive to both network bandwidth and latency. For detailed explanations of these parallelism strategies, see "Model Parallelism" on page 106.

主要并行策略产生不同的通信模式与网络需求。数据并行训练在每块 GPU 上复制完整模型，并在每个训练步后同步梯度。梯度代表改进模型预测所需调整的方向与大小：每次训练迭代中，模型做出预测、与正确答案比较、计算每个参数（权重）应如何调整以减小预测误差。每个 worker 在自己的训练数据子集上计算梯度，然后所有 worker 必须同步梯度（通常取平均）以保证一致的模型更新。对一个有数十亿参数的 LLM，每次迭代可能要在所有 worker 间传输数十 GB 梯度数据。张量并行把单个模型层切分到多块 GPU 上，在前向和反向传播中都需要传输激活。激活是每层产生的中间计算结果。例如一次矩阵乘法可能切分到 4 块 GPU 上，前向和反向传播中激活张量在它们之间传递，这使张量并行对网络延迟尤其敏感。FSDP是数据并行的内存高效替代，它把模型参数、梯度、优化器状态分片到所有 GPU 而非复制完整模型。每块 GPU 在计算时“即时”从其他 GPU 收集所需参数分片，然后丢弃以最小化内存。这种频繁的 all-gather 与 reduce-scatter 通信使 FSDP 对网络带宽和延迟都尤其敏感。这些并行策略的详细解释见第 106 页“模型并行”。
原书第 260 页

Because of this significant performance implication, it is important that platform administrators balance topology awareness with the goal of utilizing all the available resources and minimizing underutilization. A job might remain queued even when sufficient total GPU capacity exists if the GPUs are not arranged in the preferred topology, which avoids scheduling jobs with huge bottlenecks.

由于这种显著的性能影响，平台管理员必须在拓扑感知与“利用所有可用资源、最小化利用率不足”之间权衡。如果 GPU 没有按偏好拓扑排列，即使总 GPU 容量足够，作业也可能保持排队——这避免调度有巨大瓶颈的作业。

Comparing Topology-Aware Scheduling Solutions

Some of the scheduling solutions that provide gang scheduling capabilities also offer varying levels of topology awareness for optimizing GPU placement and interconnect utilization. Understanding how each solution approaches topology-aware scheduling helps platform administrators select technologies that match their infrastructure topology complexity and performance requirements. Table 7-3 compares the main options.

一些提供族群调度能力的调度方案也提供不同程度的拓扑感知，用于优化 GPU 布局与互连利用。理解每种方案如何处理拓扑感知，有助于平台管理员选择与自身基础设施拓扑复杂度和性能需求匹配的技术。表 7-3 对比了主要选项。

Coscheduling plug-in (PodGroup CRD)

The Coscheduling plug-in provides no native topology awareness beyond standard Kubernetes scheduling primitives. Platform administrators can partially bypass this limitation by manually labeling nodes with topology information (such as rack-id, nvlink-enabled, or infiniband-connected) and configuring pod affinity or anti-affinity rules in workload specifications to influence placement.

Coscheduling 插件在标准 Kubernetes 调度原语之外不提供原生拓扑感知。平台管理员可以通过手动给节点打拓扑信息标签（如 rack-id、nvlink-enabled、infiniband-connected），并在负载规范中配置 Pod 亲和/反亲和规则来影响布局，从而部分绕过这一限制。

原书第 261 页

The usage of affinity/anti-affinity features of Kubernetes is not related to the Coscheduling plug-in and is entirely a manual process. This approach works only for simple topologies with few distinct GPU interconnect types but becomes unwieldy as topology complexity increases, requiring extensive manual configuration for each training job.

Kubernetes 亲和/反亲和特性的使用与 Coscheduling 插件无关，完全是手动过程。这种方式只适用于 GPU 互连类型不多的简单拓扑；随着拓扑复杂度上升会变得难以驾驭，每个训练作业都需要大量手动配置。

Kueue

Kueue addresses topology-aware scheduling through its ResourceFlavor mechanism, enabling platform administrators to define multiple "flavors" of GPU resources differentiated by their topology characteristics. The concept is based on node labels that the platform administrator configures, or tools like NVIDIA GPU Feature Discovery ("GPU Feature Discovery" on page 84) that can automate it. A ResourceFlavor selects nodes using nodeLabels (e.g., gpu-interconnect: nvlink, network-fabric: infiniband, rack: rack-1) and tolerations, creating logical resource pools that workloads can request through queue configurations. When a ClusterQueue references multiple ResourceFlavors with different topology characteristics, Kueue's admission controller can enforce topology constraints by admitting workloads only when resources matching the requested flavor are available.

Kueue 通过 ResourceFlavor 机制处理拓扑感知调度，让平台管理员能按拓扑特征定义多种 GPU 资源“风味”。这个概念基于平台管理员配置的节点标签，或 NVIDIA GPU Feature Discovery（见第 84 页“GPU Feature Discovery”）等自动化工具。ResourceFlavor 用 nodeLabels（如 gpu-interconnect: nvlink、network-fabric: infiniband、rack: rack-1）和容忍选择节点，创建逻辑资源池，负载可通过队列配置请求。当 ClusterQueue 引用多个具有不同拓扑特征的 ResourceFlavor 时，Kueue 准入控制器只有在匹配所请求风味的资源可用时才接纳负载，从而强制执行拓扑约束。

This approach enables sophisticated topology awareness without requiring application-level changes. Workloads specify queue names, and Kueue handles topology-aware placement through its integration with the underlying scheduler. First, you need to define the ResourceFlavors, as in Example 7-6.

这种方式无需应用层改动即可实现复杂拓扑感知。负载指定队列名，Kueue 通过与底层调度器的集成处理拓扑感知布局。首先需要定义 ResourceFlavor，如例 7-6。

Example 7-6. Kueue ResourceFlavor definition

# ResourceFlavor for premium GPU nodes with NVLink and InfiniBand
apiVersion: kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: ResourceFlavor
metadata:
  name: gpu-nvlink-infiniband
spec:
  nodeLabels:
    # Select nodes where GPUs are connected via NVLink
    gpu-interconnect: nvlink
    # Select nodes where inter-node communication happens via Infiniband
    network-fabric: infiniband
    gpu-type: nvidia-h100
  ...

# ResourceFlavor for standard GPU nodes with Ethernet
apiVersion: kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: ResourceFlavor
metadata:
  name: gpu-standard-ethernet
spec:
  nodeLabels:
    # Nodes that use PCIe for GPU interconnect and Ethernet for networking
    gpu-interconnect: pcie
    network-fabric: ethernet
    gpu-type: nvidia-h100
  ...
原书第 262 页

After the ResourceFlavors are defined, you can use them to configure working queue resource requirements, as shown in Example 7-7.

定义 ResourceFlavor 后，可以用它们配置工作队列的资源需求，如例 7-7。

Example 7-7. Kueue ClusterQueue and LocalQueue creation

# ClusterQueue with topology-aware resource flavors
apiVersion: kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: ClusterQueue
metadata:
  name: topology-aware-cluster-queue
spec:
  namespaceSelector: {}
  resourceGroups:
  - coveredResources: ["cpu", "memory", "nvidia.com/gpu"]
    flavors:
    # The premium flavor listed first so Kueue tries this flavor first
    - name: gpu-nvlink-infiniband
      resources:
      - name: nvidia.com/gpu
        nominalQuota: 16
      ...
    # When premium quota is exhausted, this second flavor is used
    - name: gpu-standard-ethernet
      resources:
      - name: nvidia.com/gpu
        nominalQuota: 32
      ...
  flavorFungibility:
    # This option allows fallback to next flavor when the first is exhausted
    whenCanBorrow: TryNextFlavor
    whenCanPreempt: Preempt

# LocalQueue for team access
apiVersion: kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: LocalQueue
metadata:
  name: team-queue
spec:
  clusterQueue: topology-aware-cluster-queue

apiVersion: kubeflow.org/v1
kind: PyTorchJob
metadata:
  name: llm-training
  labels:
    # This label triggers the Kueue admission controller and
    # binds the job to a specific queue
    kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name: team-queue
spec:
  ...

NVIDIA KAI Scheduler

The KAI Scheduler provides the most sophisticated GPU topology awareness, with native understanding of NVIDIA GPU interconnect technologies, including NVLink, NVSwitch, NVLink bridges, and their relationship to network fabrics like InfiniBand. The KAI Scheduler integrates tightly with the NVIDIA GPU Operator (see "NVIDIA GPU Operator" on page 95) to access detailed GPU information and make topology-aware scheduling decisions, limiting the need for manual labeling by platform administrators.

KAI Scheduler 提供最成熟的 GPU 拓扑感知，原生理解 NVIDIA GPU 互连技术——包括 NVLink、NVSwitch、NVLink 桥接，以及它们与 InfiniBand 等网络 fabric 的关系。KAI Scheduler 与 NVIDIA GPU Operator（见第 95 页“NVIDIA GPU Operator”）紧密集成以获取详细 GPU 信息并做出拓扑感知调度决策，减少平台管理员手动打标签的需求。

The scheduler analyzes GPU topology when placing distributed training jobs, automatically co-locating workers on nodes with optimal network configuration. For example, it is preferable to place a training job that requires eight GPUs on a single node where each GPU is connected to the others via NVSwitch connectivity, rather than spreading GPUs across multiple nodes via InfiniBand. While Kueue manages topology awareness at the admission layer through ResourceFlavors (deciding which hardware tier to use), KAI Scheduler integrates topology optimization directly into scheduling decisions alongside gang scheduling and fair-share capabilities, ensuring that topology-optimized placements don't violate quota policies or create resource fragmentation.

调度器在放置分布式训练作业时分析 GPU 拓扑，自动把 worker 共置到网络配置最优的节点上。例如，需要 8 块 GPU 的训练作业最好放在单节点上、每块 GPU 通过 NVSwitch 与其他 GPU 互连，而不是通过 InfiniBand 散布到多节点。Kueue 通过 ResourceFlavor 在准入层管理拓扑感知（决定用哪一档硬件），而 KAI Scheduler 把拓扑优化直接集成到调度决策中，与族群调度和公平共享能力并行，确保拓扑优化布局不违反配额策略、也不造成资源碎片。

This deep GPU topology integration and NVIDIA-specific hardware awareness makes KAI Scheduler the natural choice for large-scale NVIDIA GPU clusters where training performance depends critically on GPU interconnect selection, particularly when combined with NVIDIA-specific features like Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) partitioning and fractional GPU allocation described in "Sub-GPU Allocation" on page 98.

这种深度 GPU 拓扑集成与 NVIDIA 硬件专用感知，使 KAI Scheduler 成为大规模 NVIDIA GPU 集群的自然选择——在这些集群中训练性能关键取决于 GPU 互连选择，尤其是结合多实例 GPU（MIG）分区与 fractional GPU 分配（见第 98 页“子 GPU 分配”）等 NVIDIA 专用特性时。

原书第 264 页

Volcano

The Volcano scheduler includes topology-aware scheduling plug-ins that optimize pod placement based on hardware topology information provided through node labels. Like Kueue's ResourceFlavor approach, platform administrators must label nodes with topology characteristics (e.g., gpu-interconnect: nvlink, network-fabric: infiniband, rack-id: rack-1), which Volcano's topology plug-ins consume to score nodes higher when they provide optimal interconnect bandwidth for the job's GPU requirements.

Volcano 调度器包含拓扑感知调度插件，基于节点标签提供的硬件拓扑信息优化 Pod 布局。与 Kueue 的 ResourceFlavor 方式类似，平台管理员必须给节点打上拓扑特征标签（如 gpu-interconnect: nvlink、network-fabric: infiniband、rack-id: rack-1），Volcano 的拓扑插件消费这些标签，在节点能为作业 GPU 需求提供最优互连带宽时给更高评分。

However, while Kueue uses ResourceFlavors as admission-time abstractions delegating actual placement to the underlying scheduler, Volcano integrates topology scoring directly into its scheduling decisions, automatically co-locating distributed training workers on nodes within the same rack or with direct NVLink connectivity without requiring explicit affinity rules.

不过，Kueue 把 ResourceFlavor 用作准入时的抽象、把实际布局委托给底层调度器，而 Volcano 把拓扑评分直接集成进调度决策，自动把分布式训练 worker 共置到同机架节点或有直连 NVLink 的节点上，无需显式亲和规则。

Making the right choice

For organizations requiring advanced topology awareness, layering different solutions creates comprehensive topology-aware gang scheduling. A common architecture combines Kueue's admission control with topology-aware schedulers like Volcano or KAI Scheduler so that Kueue manages admission at the job level through ResourceFlavor topology selection, while the underlying scheduler handles detailed topology-optimized pod placement. This separation of concerns enables platform administrators to enforce topology policies at the admission layer (jobs requesting premium interconnects must have appropriate quotas), while delegating placement optimization to specialized schedulers with deep topology understanding.

对于需要高级拓扑感知的组织，分层组合不同方案可形成全面的拓扑感知族群调度。常见架构是把 Kueue 的准入控制与 Volcano 或 KAI Scheduler 等拓扑感知调度器结合：Kueue 通过 ResourceFlavor 拓扑选择在作业层管理准入，底层调度器处理详细的拓扑优化 Pod 布局。这种关注点分离让平台管理员在准入层执行拓扑策略（请求高级互连的作业必须有相应配额），同时把布局优化委托给具有深度拓扑理解的专用调度器。

Platform administrators configure topology information by labeling nodes accordingly (rack ID, network fabric type, GPU interconnect capabilities) and creating topology-aware configurations in their chosen scheduler. Different GPU vendors provide tools to simplify this labeling; in particular, the NVIDIA suite is advanced and comprehensive.

平台管理员通过相应地给节点打标签（机架 ID、网络 fabric 类型、GPU 互连能力）并在所选调度器中创建拓扑感知配置来配置拓扑信息。不同 GPU 厂商提供工具简化这种打标签；NVIDIA 的套件尤其先进全面。

While the schedulers discussed earlier focus on topology awareness for placing pods across nodes based on GPU interconnect characteristics, topology considerations also matter at the individual node level where CPU and device locality affect performance. This challenge has been addressed in Kubernetes through the Topology Manager component (see the following sidebar).

前面讨论的调度器聚焦于根据 GPU 互连特征跨节点布局 Pod，而在单节点层面，CPU 与设备的局部性也影响性能。Kubernetes 通过 Topology Manager 组件应对这一挑战（见下面边栏）。

Sidebar: Kubernetes Topology Manager

The Kubernetes Topology Manager is a Kubelet component that runs on every node and complements scheduler-level topology policies by coordinating resource allocation to ensure optimal hardware locality for individual pods. One of the main aspects to consider for optimal hardware usage on modern multisocket servers is the Non-Uniform Memory Access (NUMA) memory architecture: each CPU socket has its own local memory, and accessing memory attached to a different socket incurs higher latency. This is a critical consideration for GPU-intensive workloads where cross-NUMA memory access can significantly degrade performance. Before Topology Manager, the CPU Manager and Device Manager in Kubernetes made resource allocation decisions independently, potentially assigning CPUs from one NUMA node and GPUs from another NUMA node to the same pod, forcing cross-NUMA memory traffic (Figure 7-3). Topology Manager addresses this by enabling CPU and device (including GPU) topology awareness for individual pods, ensuring that CPUs and GPUs allocated to a pod are NUMA-local to minimize memory access latency. Platform administrators can configure Topology Manager with different policies: best-effort attempts NUMA alignment without enforcing it, restricted only admits pods when resources can be properly aligned, and single-numa-node requires all pod resources to come from a single NUMA node. This is the strictest policy that guarantees optimal locality but may reduce scheduling flexibility in resource-constrained clusters.

Kubernetes Topology Manager 是运行在每个节点上的 Kubelet 组件，通过协调资源分配确保单个 Pod 的硬件局部性最优，补充调度器层的拓扑策略。在现代多插槽服务器上优化硬件使用时，一个主要考量是 NUMA（非一致内存访问）架构：每个 CPU 插槽有自己的本地内存，访问挂在另一个插槽上的内存延迟更高。对 GPU 密集负载这是关键考量——跨 NUMA 内存访问会显著降低性能。在 Topology Manager 之前，Kubernetes 的 CPU Manager 与 Device Manager 独立做资源分配决策，可能把来自一个 NUMA 节点的 CPU 和另一个 NUMA 节点的 GPU 分配给同一 Pod，强制跨 NUMA 内存流量。Topology Manager 通过让 CPU 与设备（包括 GPU）对单个 Pod 拓扑感知来解决这一问题，确保分配给 Pod 的 CPU 和 GPU 在 NUMA 局部以最小化内存访问延迟。平台管理员可为 Topology Manager 配置不同策略：best-effort 尝试 NUMA 对齐但不强制；restricted 仅在资源能正确对齐时接纳 Pod；single-numa-node 要求 Pod 所有资源来自单个 NUMA 节点——这是最严格的策略，保证最优局部性，但在资源受限集群中可能降低调度灵活性。

原书第 266 页

While topology-aware scheduling optimizes individual job placement for performance, it doesn't address the fundamental challenge of fairly allocating scarce GPU resources across multiple competing teams in a shared cluster.

拓扑感知调度为性能优化单个作业的布局，但它不解决在共享集群中跨多个竞争团队公平分配稀缺 GPU 资源这一根本挑战。

Quota Management and Multitenancy: GPU as a Service
配额管理与多租户：GPU 即服务

While gang scheduling ensures that all pods in a distributed job are scheduled together, and topology-aware scheduling optimizes their placement on hardware with optimal interconnects, these mechanisms address only how individual jobs are executed. They do not address who gets access to scarce GPU resources when multiple teams compete for cluster capacity.

族群调度确保分布式作业的所有 Pod 一起调度，拓扑感知调度把它们优化布局到具有最优互连的硬件上，但这些机制只解决单个作业如何执行。它们不解决当多个团队竞争集群容量时，谁能访问稀缺 GPU 资源。

Operating a shared GPU cluster as a multitenant platform requires sophisticated quota management to ensure fair resource allocation across teams while maximizing overall GPU utilization. This is a challenge that standard Kubernetes ResourceQuotas cannot adequately address for AI/ML workloads.

把共享 GPU 集群作为多租户平台运营，需要复杂的配额管理来确保跨团队公平分配资源，同时最大化整体 GPU 利用率。这是标准 Kubernetes ResourceQuota 无法为 AI/ML 负载充分解决的挑战。

Traditional Kubernetes quotas operate at the namespace level with hard limits that prevent workloads from starting when the quota is exhausted, but this approach does not address fixed and scarce resources, leading to poor GPU utilization in practice. A team might have unused quota while its data scientists are not running experiments, while the jobs of another team queue indefinitely despite having urgent training deadlines, with expensive GPU resources sitting unused because quota boundaries prevent dynamic sharing.

传统 Kubernetes 配额在命名空间级别用硬限制操作——配额耗尽时阻止负载启动，但这种方式不处理固定且稀缺的资源，实际中导致 GPU 利用率低下。一个团队的数据科学家没跑实验时配额闲置，而另一个团队有紧急训练截止日期的作业却无限排队，昂贵 GPU 资源因配额边界阻止动态共享而闲置。

GPU as a Service (GPUaaS) architectures address this by implementing hierarchical quota management with borrowing, preemption, and fairness policies that enable teams to burst beyond their guaranteed allocations when cluster capacity is available, while ensuring that no team can monopolize resources when demand exceeds supply. The main goal is to maximize GPU usage with an opportunistic approach, while at the same time guaranteeing the designed quota when asked.

GPU 即服务（GPUaaS）架构通过实现分层配额管理（含借用、抢占、公平策略）来应对这一问题——当集群容量可用时允许团队突发超出其保障分配，同时确保需求超过供给时没有团队能独占资源。主要目标是以机会主义方式最大化 GPU 使用，同时在被索要时保证设计配额。

Comparing Quota Management and Multitenancy Solutions

Several scheduling solutions provide quota management capabilities for GPU resources, each with different approaches to resource allocation, fairness policies, and multitenancy support. Table 7-4 compares the main options. Understanding how each solution handles quota enforcement and resource borrowing helps platform administrators select technologies that match their organizational requirements for fair GPU sharing across teams.

有多种调度方案提供 GPU 资源配额管理能力，每种在资源分配、公平策略与多租户支持上方式不同。表 7-4 对比主要选项。理解每种方案如何处理配额执行与资源借用，有助于平台管理员选择匹配自身组织跨团队公平 GPU 共享需求的技术。

Kueue

Kueue provides a comprehensive quota management system designed specifically for batch workloads like training jobs, implementing a two-tier architecture that separates cluster-wide resource governance from team-level queue management.

Kueue 提供专为训练作业等批负载设计的全面配额管理系统，实现两层架构，把集群级资源治理与团队级队列管理分离。

At the cluster level, ClusterQueues define resource pools with quota limits for CPU, memory, and GPUs, along with policies for how resources are allocated when multiple teams compete for limited capacity. Platform administrators create ClusterQueues representing different resource tiers, for example, a "gpu-training" ClusterQueue with 32 NVIDIA H100 GPUs for production training workloads, a "gpu-development" ClusterQueue with 8 GPUs for experimentation, and a "gpu-spot" ClusterQueue using cloud spot instances for cost-sensitive workloads. Each ClusterQueue specifies nominal quotas (guaranteed resources available to workloads) and borrowing limits (maximum resources that can be temporarily borrowed from other queues when they are idle), implementing flexible capacity sharing that improves utilization without sacrificing fairness guarantees. LocalQueues provide the team-facing interface for submitting workloads, mapping to specific ClusterQueues and enabling namespace-scoped job submission with automatic quota enforcement.

在集群级，ClusterQueue 定义资源池，带 CPU、内存、GPU 的配额限制，以及多团队竞争有限容量时如何分配资源的策略。平台管理员创建代表不同资源档位的 ClusterQueue，例如：一个 32 块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 的 gpu-training ClusterQueue 用于生产训练负载；一个 8 GPU 的 gpu-development 用于实验；一个用云 spot 实例的 gpu-spot 用于成本敏感负载。每个 ClusterQueue 指定 nominal quota（负载可获得的保障资源）和 borrowing limit（其他队列空闲时可临时借用的最大资源），实现灵活容量共享——在不牺牲公平保证的前提下提升利用率。LocalQueue 提供面向团队提交负载的接口，映射到特定 ClusterQueue，支持命名空间范围的作业提交并自动执行配额。

原书第 268 页

The cohort management feature implements resource borrowing by grouping different ClusterQueues to enable sophisticated multitenant sharing policies. Each ClusterQueue contributes to the cohort total quota with the reserved quota so that the total capacity is the sum of all of them. When Team A has pending workloads but has exhausted its 10 GPU quota, Kueue allows the team to borrow unused capacity from Team B's and Team C's quotas, up to the cohort limit. Kueue automatically scales Team A's effective allocation to utilize idle GPUs, but immediately preempts those borrowed resources when Team B or Team C submit new jobs that require their guaranteed quota. This dynamic sharing dramatically improves cluster utilization compared to hard quota boundaries. GPUs are never idle while jobs are pending, while maintaining fairness guarantees that ensure each team can always access its nominal quota allocation. Additionally, Kueue supports hierarchical queues that can model complex organizational structures, allowing platform administrators to map department hierarchies, project teams, and resource pools to reflect real-world organizational boundaries.

cohort 管理功能通过把不同 ClusterQueue 分组来实现资源借用，支持复杂的多租户共享策略。每个 ClusterQueue 把预留配额贡献给 cohort 总配额，总容量是所有成员之和。当团队 A 有 pending 负载但已用尽其 10 GPU 配额时，Kueue 允许它在 cohort 限额内借用团队 B 和 C 配额中的空闲容量。Kueue 自动扩展团队 A 的有效分配以利用空闲 GPU，但当团队 B 或 C 提交需要其保障配额的新作业时，立即抢占这些借用的资源。与硬配额边界相比，这种动态共享显著提升集群利用率——作业 pending 时 GPU 从不空闲，同时保持公平保证，确保每个团队总能访问其 nominal quota。此外，Kueue 支持分层队列，可建模复杂组织结构，让平台管理员映射部门层级、项目团队与资源池，反映真实组织边界。

Example 7-9 includes all of these features: cohort, nominal quota, borrowing limits, and priority classes.

例 7-9 包含所有这些特性：cohort、nominal quota、借用限制与优先级类。

Example 7-9. Kueue quota management with cohorts and priority classes

apiVersion: kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: ClusterQueue
metadata:
  name: team-a-queue
spec:
  cohort: shared-gpu-cohort
  resourceGroups:
  - coveredResources: ["cpu", "memory", "nvidia.com/gpu"]
    flavors:
    # Using a built-in ResourceFlavor that matches all nodes.
    - name: default-flavor
      resources:
      - name: nvidia.com/gpu
        nominalQuota: 10
        borrowingLimit: 22
  queueingStrategy: BestEffortFIFO
  preemption:
    reclaimWithinCohort: Any
    withinClusterQueue: LowerPriority
---
# High-priority class for production workloads
apiVersion: kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: WorkloadPriorityClass
metadata:
  name: production-priority
spec:
  # Specifying a high value makes this class higher priority
  value: 10000
  description: "High priority for production training jobs"
---
# Production PyTorchJob from Team A (high priority)
apiVersion: kubeflow.org/v1
kind: PyTorchJob
metadata:
  name: production-llm-training
  namespace: team-a
  labels:
    # The definition of the LocalQueue is skipped here for brevity
    kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name: team-a-training-queue
    kueue.x-k8s.io/priority-class: production-priority
  ...

  • 多个 ClusterQueue 属于同一 cohort shared-gpu-cohort，支持跨团队资源借用。总容量是该 cohort 中所有 ClusterQueue 配额之和。
  • BestEffortFIFO 排队策略按先进先出顺序处理负载，同时尽力高效打包资源。配额可用时按提交顺序接纳作业。
  • reclaimWithinCohort: Any 策略允许任何团队在需要收回 nominal quota 时抢占借用的资源。
  • withinClusterQueue: LowerPriority 策略允许同一 ClusterQueue 内高优先级负载在配额耗尽时抢占低优先级负载。
  • 这个生产作业使用 production-priority，意味着 Kueue 会在实验作业之前接纳它，必要时还能抢占实验作业。

Sidebar: Kueue fair-share algorithm

Kueue's fair-share algorithm considers the history of resource consumption for each team and current queue depth, prioritizing teams that have consumed fewer resources recently or have been waiting longer for admission. It implements a queuing strategy that balances fairness (ensuring all teams get access) with efficiency (preferring to admit larger jobs that can utilize resources effectively). The priority classes enable urgent production training jobs to preempt lower-priority experimental workloads, allowing organizations to implement service-level agreements where certain teams or job types receive preferential access during peak demand periods, while still sharing capacity during other times.

Kueue 的公平共享算法考虑每个团队的历史资源消耗与当前队列深度，优先处理近期消耗资源较少或等待准入更久的团队。它实现一种排队策略，在公平（确保所有团队都能访问）与效率（优先接纳能有效利用资源的更大作业）之间平衡。优先级类让紧急生产训练作业能抢占低优先级实验负载，使组织能实施服务级别协议——某些团队或作业类型在高峰时段获得优先访问，其他时段仍共享容量。
原书第 270 页

NVIDIA KAI Scheduler

NVIDIA KAI Scheduler implements GPU-specific quota management with hierarchical queue structures designed for large-scale GPU clusters. It provides fair-share scheduling across teams, with GPU topology awareness integrated into quota allocation decisions.

NVIDIA KAI Scheduler 实现 GPU 专用配额管理，带为大规模 GPU 集群设计的分层队列结构。它提供跨团队的公平共享调度，并把 GPU 拓扑感知集成进配额分配决策。

Unlike Kueue, which operates as an admission controller layer working with any underlying scheduler, KAI Scheduler is a complete scheduler replacement that handles both quota enforcement and pod placement decisions in a single component. This enables tighter integration between quota policies and GPU-specific scheduling optimizations, like fractional GPU allocation and Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) support.

Kueue 作为准入控制器层与任何底层调度器配合，而 KAI Scheduler 是完整的调度器替换，在单个组件中同时处理配额执行与 Pod 布局决策。这使配额策略与 GPU 专用调度优化（如 fractional GPU 分配与多实例 GPU MIG 支持）之间集成更紧密。

However, this tight coupling means that adopting KAI Scheduler requires replacing the default Kubernetes scheduler entirely. Kueue can work alongside the default kube-scheduler or be layered on top of specialized schedulers like KAI Scheduler itself, creating architectures where Kueue manages quota and admission control, while KAI Scheduler optimizes GPU placement.

但这种紧耦合意味着采用 KAI Scheduler 需要完全替换默认 Kubernetes 调度器。Kueue 可以与默认 kube-scheduler 并肩工作，也可以叠加在 KAI Scheduler 等专用调度器之上，形成 Kueue 管理配额与准入控制、KAI Scheduler 优化 GPU 布局的架构。

Volcano

Volcano scheduler implements its own queue abstraction with quota management through Queue CRDs that define resource limits and priorities, providing an alternative to Kueue's ClusterQueue/LocalQueue model. Volcano queues include reclaim policies that enable preemption of lower-priority jobs when higher-priority workloads arrive, and proportional resource allocation that divides cluster capacity across queues based on configured weights.

Volcano 调度器通过 Queue CRD 实现自己的队列抽象与配额管理（定义资源限制与优先级），提供 Kueue 的 ClusterQueue/LocalQueue 模型的替代方案。Volcano 队列包含回收策略——当高优先级负载到达时抢占低优先级作业；以及按比例资源分配——按配置权重把集群容量划分到各队列。

Unlike Kueue, which separates admission control from scheduling mechanics and works as a layer above the scheduler, Volcano implements both queue management and gang scheduling in a single scheduler component. This provides a more monolithic approach that requires replacing kube-scheduler entirely, but offers tighter integration between quota policies and scheduling decisions.

Kueue 把准入控制与调度机制分离、作为调度器之上的层工作，而 Volcano 在单个调度器组件中同时实现队列管理与族群调度。这提供更单体化的方式——需要完全替换 kube-scheduler，但配额策略与调度决策之间集成更紧密。

Making the right choice

The choice between these quota management approaches depends on organizational requirements and existing infrastructure. Kueue excels in cloud-native environments where maintaining the default Kubernetes scheduler is preferred, providing battle-tested admission control that is GPU vendor agnostic. Kueue integrates seamlessly with Kubeflow Trainer and other Kubernetes-native tooling, with a clear separation between policy (quota management) and mechanism (scheduling). NVIDIA KAI Scheduler suits GPU-heavy deployments where GPU-specific optimizations justify scheduler replacement, particularly for organizations running thousands of GPUs where fractional allocation and topology-aware placement provide measurable efficiency gains.

这些配额管理方案之间的选择取决于组织需求与现有基础设施。Kueue 在偏好保留默认 Kubernetes 调度器的云原生环境中表现出色，提供久经考验、与 GPU 厂商无关的准入控制。Kueue 与 Kubeflow Trainer 及其他 Kubernetes 原生工具无缝集成，策略（配额管理）与机制（调度）清晰分离。NVIDIA KAI Scheduler 适合重 GPU 部署——GPU 专用优化足以成为替换调度器的理由，尤其是运行数千 GPU、fractional 分配与拓扑感知布局可带来可度量效率提升的组织。

原书第 271 页

Volcano offers a complete scheduling solution for organizations willing to replace kube-scheduler in exchange for integrated gang scheduling and quota management in a single component. Platform administrators should evaluate whether to layer Kueue over their chosen scheduler (maintaining flexibility) or adopt an integrated scheduler with built-in quota management (reducing architectural complexity), recognizing that Kueue can complement GPU-aware schedulers like KAI Scheduler by handling admission control, while the scheduler optimizes GPU placement.

Volcano 为愿意替换 kube-scheduler 以换取单组件内集成族群调度与配额管理的组织提供完整调度方案。平台管理员应评估是在所选调度器上叠加 Kueue（保持灵活性），还是采用内建配额管理的集成调度器（降低架构复杂度）——并认识到 Kueue 可以补充 KAI Scheduler 等 GPU 感知调度器，处理准入控制，而调度器优化 GPU 布局。

Understanding how Kueue's ResourceFlavor selection interacts with priority classes is essential for configuring effective quota policies (see the following sidebar).

理解 Kueue 的 ResourceFlavor 选择如何与优先级类交互，对配置有效的配额策略至关重要（见下面边栏）。

Sidebar: Kueue Priority Classes and ResourceFlavor

Kueue evaluates ResourceFlavors in the order they appear in the ClusterQueue's flavors list: 1. First attempt — try the first flavor listed (in the previous example, gpu-nvlink-infiniband). If sufficient GPUs are available in the nominal quota, admit the workload to this flavor. 2. Automatic fallback — if the first flavor's quota is exhausted, Kueue automatically tries the next flavor in the list (e.g., gpu-standard-ethernet). 3. Borrowing behavior — the flavorFungibility.whenCanBorrow setting controls what happens when borrowing from the cohort is possible but the nominal quota is exhausted: MayStopSearch (default) — if borrowing is feasible in the current flavor, use it (stop searching for other flavors); TryNextFlavor — even if borrowing is possible in the current flavor, continue evaluating the next flavor to prefer nominal quota over borrowed resources. 4. Node selector injection — once Kueue selects a flavor, it injects the flavor's nodeLabels as node selectors, ensuring that pods schedule only on topology-appropriate nodes. The order of flavors in the list determines preference—premium topology comes first, standard topology is the fallback. How does this relate to Priority classes? Kueue has the concept of priority classes (WorkloadPriorityClass CRD), and it serves a different purpose than the ResourceFlavor selection: ResourceFlavor selection determines which topology and hardware a workload gets (controlled by flavor order and availability). Priority classes determine which workload gets admitted first when multiple workloads are pending (controlled by the priority value). When multiple training jobs are queued waiting for resources, Kueue uses priority to decide the admission order: higher priority workloads are admitted first when quota becomes available; preemption lets high-priority workloads evict running low-priority workloads to reclaim quota; same priority uses FIFO ordering within the same priority level; fair sharing prevents resource monopolization by ordering workloads based on historical resource usage, giving preference to queues that have consumed fewer resources over time and ensuring that underutilized teams can make progress even in busy clusters.

Kueue 按 ResourceFlavor 在 ClusterQueue flavors 列表中的出现顺序评估：1. 首次尝试——先试列表中第一个风味（上例中是 gpu-nvlink-infiniband）。若 nominal quota 中有足够 GPU，就把负载接纳到该风味。2. 自动回退——若第一个风味配额耗尽，Kueue 自动尝试列表中下一个风味（如 gpu-standard-ethernet）。3. 借用行为——flavorFungibility.whenCanBorrow 控制当可从 cohort 借用但 nominal quota 耗尽时的行为：MayStopSearch（默认）——若当前风味可借用就用它（停止搜索其他风味）；TryNextFlavor——即使当前风味可借用，也继续评估下一个风味，优先用 nominal quota 而非借用资源。4. 节点选择器注入——Kueue 选定风味后，把该风味的 nodeLabels 作为 node selector 注入，确保 Pod 只调度到拓扑合适的节点。列表中风味顺序决定偏好——高级拓扑在前，标准拓扑兜底。这与优先级类有何关系？Kueue 有优先级类（WorkloadPriorityClass CRD）概念，它与 ResourceFlavor 选择目的不同：ResourceFlavor 选择决定负载获得哪种拓扑与硬件（由风味顺序与可用性控制）；优先级类决定多个负载 pending 时谁先被接纳（由优先级值控制）。当多个训练作业排队等资源时，Kueue 用优先级决定接纳顺序：配额可用时高优先级负载先被接纳；抢占允许高优先级负载驱逐运行中的低优先级负载以收回配额；同优先级内 FIFO；公平共享基于历史资源使用排序负载，偏好近期消耗资源较少的队列，确保利用率低的团队在繁忙集群中也能推进。
