With gang scheduling ensuring complete allocations, topology-aware placement optimizing GPU interconnects, and quota management enabling fair multitenant access, the scheduling infrastructure is complete. However, even optimally scheduled distributed training jobs face a critical performance bottleneck: network communication between workers during gradient synchronization.

族群调度确保完整分配、拓扑感知布局优化 GPU 互连、配额管理实现公平多租户访问，调度基础设施就此完备。然而即使调度最优的分布式训练作业也面临一个关键性能瓶颈：梯度同步期间 worker 之间的网络通信。

Network Optimization for Distributed Training
分布式训练的网络优化

Throughout the previous sections on topology-aware scheduling, we referenced network interconnect technologies like NVLink, InfiniBand, and RoCE as critical factors influencing scheduler placement decisions. This section focuses on network communication as one of the most critical performance bottlenecks in distributed deep learning, where different parallelism strategies, such as data parallelism, tensor parallelism, and pipeline parallelism, each generate distinct communication patterns with different performance characteristics and network requirements. The different model parallelism strategies are explained in detail in "Model Parallelism" on page 106.

在前面拓扑感知调度各节中，我们把 NVLink、InfiniBand、RoCE 等网络互连技术作为影响调度器布局决策的关键因素提及。本节聚焦网络通信这一分布式深度学习最关键的性能瓶颈之一——不同并行策略（数据并行、张量并行、流水线并行）各自产生不同通信模式，具有不同性能特征与网络需求。不同模型并行策略详见第 106 页“模型并行”。

Distributed training frameworks like PyTorch FSDP and DeepSpeed execute collective communication operations like all-reduce, all-gather, reduce-scatter, and point-to-point transfers during each training iteration, creating network traffic patterns that differ fundamentally from traditional application workloads.

PyTorch FSDP、DeepSpeed 等分布式训练框架在每次训练迭代中执行 all-reduce、all-gather、reduce-scatter、点对点传输等集合通信操作，产生与传统应用负载根本不同的网络流量模式。

Understanding these communication patterns and their network requirements enables platform administrators to make informed infrastructure decisions that match network topology to workload characteristics.

理解这些通信模式及其网络需求，让平台管理员能做出明智的基础设施决策，使网络拓扑匹配负载特征。

Sidebar: Collective Communication Operations

Distributed training relies on three fundamental collective communication patterns: All-reduce — each worker computes gradients locally, then all workers combine (typically sum or average) their gradients and distribute the result back to all workers. This is the most common operation in data-parallel training, ensuring all workers have identical gradient updates before applying optimizer steps. All-gather — each worker contributes its data, and all workers receive the complete concatenated dataset from all participants. Used in model-parallel training where different workers hold different model shards and need to exchange activation tensors or partial results. Broadcast — one worker (typically rank-0) sends identical data to all other workers. Used for distributing initial model weights, hyperparameters, or checkpoint data from the rank-0 node to all workers. These operations execute synchronously, stopping the work on all the workers. This makes network latency and bandwidth critical bottlenecks that directly impact training throughput.

分布式训练依赖三种基本集合通信模式：All-reduce——每个 worker 本地计算梯度，然后所有 worker 合并（通常求和或平均）梯度并把结果分发给所有 worker。这是数据并行训练中最常见的操作，确保所有 worker 在应用优化器步之前有相同的梯度更新。All-gather——每个 worker 贡献自己的数据，所有 worker 收到所有参与者拼接后的完整数据集。用于模型并行训练——不同 worker 持有不同模型分片，需要交换激活张量或部分结果。Broadcast——一个 worker（通常 rank-0）向所有其他 worker 发送相同数据，用于把初始模型权重、超参数或检查点数据从 rank-0 节点分发给所有 worker。这些操作同步执行，停止所有 worker 的工作，使网络延迟与带宽成为直接影响训练吞吐的关键瓶颈。
原书第 274 页

A typical LLM training job with 8 nodes and 64 GPUs might synchronize billions of parameters every few seconds, generating sustained network traffic measured in hundreds of gigabits per second, with communication latency directly impacting training throughput as GPUs idle while waiting for synchronization to complete.

一个典型的 8 节点 64 GPU LLM 训练作业可能每隔几秒同步数十亿参数，产生每秒数百 Gbps 的持续网络流量，通信延迟直接影响训练吞吐——GPU 在等待同步完成时空转。

Hardware vendors typically sell specialized "AI nodes" (such as NVIDIA DGX systems, Dell PowerEdge XE servers, or HPE Cray EX systems) that bundle high-end GPUs, up to eight per node, with CPUs, memory, and optimized intra-node interconnects like NVLink that provide hundreds of gigabytes per second of bandwidth between GPUs within the same server. This addresses single-node communication bottlenecks through integrated hardware design rather than requiring platform administrators to manually optimize GPU-to-GPU connectivity. The challenge intensifies as training scales beyond single nodes.

硬件厂商通常销售专用“AI 节点”（如 NVIDIA DGX 系统、Dell PowerEdge XE 服务器、HPE Cray EX 系统），把高端 GPU（每节点最多 8 块）与 CPU、内存、NVLink 等优化的节点内互连打包，在同一服务器内 GPU 间提供每秒数百 GB 带宽。这通过集成硬件设计解决单节点通信瓶颈，无需平台管理员手动优化 GPU 间连接。当训练扩展到单节点之外，挑战加剧。

Standard Kubernetes networking is designed for microservices with limited east-west traffic and north-south API calls, and it fails to provide the required performance characteristics. Additionally, default CNI plug-ins like OVN-Kubernetes introduce network virtualization overhead that further degrades performance for high-bandwidth distributed training workloads. The traditional TCP/IP network stack involves kernel context switches, copied buffer, and the standard Ethernet bandwidth becomes the final bottleneck for collective operations.

标准 Kubernetes 网络为东西向流量有限、南北向 API 调用的微服务设计，无法提供所需性能特征。此外，OVN-Kubernetes 等默认 CNI 插件引入网络虚拟化开销，进一步降低高带宽分布式训练负载的性能。传统 TCP/IP 网络栈涉及内核上下文切换、缓冲区拷贝，标准以太网带宽成为集合操作的最终瓶颈。

Sidebar: East-West and North-South Network Traffic

In data center networking terminology, traffic patterns are categorized by direction: North-south traffic is communication between clients outside the data center and services inside (e.g., users accessing a web application, or external API calls). This traffic "enters" and "exits" the data center, crossing the perimeter firewall. East-west traffic is communication between services within the data center (e.g., microservice-to-microservice calls, or database queries from application servers). This traffic flows laterally across the internal network without leaving the data center. Traditional Kubernetes networking optimizes for microservices with predominantly north-south traffic (serving external requests) and moderate east-west traffic (internal service communication). Distributed training workloads invert this pattern, generating massive east-west traffic for gradient synchronization between worker pods while requiring minimal north-south connectivity.

在数据中心网络术语中，流量模式按方向分类：南北向流量是数据中心外部客户端与内部服务之间的通信（如用户访问 Web 应用、外部 API 调用）。这种流量“进出”数据中心，穿过边界防火墙。东西向流量是数据中心内部服务之间的通信（如微服务间调用、应用服务器的数据库查询）。这种流量在内部网络横向流动，不离开数据中心。传统 Kubernetes 网络优化的是微服务——以南北向流量（服务外部请求）为主、东西向流量（内部服务通信）适中。分布式训练负载反转了这一模式：产生海量东西向流量用于 worker Pod 间梯度同步，而南北向连接需求极少。
原书第 275 页

Platform administrators deploying production training platforms must therefore implement specialized network configurations that bypass standard kernel networking stacks and leverage high-performance interconnect technologies originally developed for HPC workloads. The industry now directly applies decades of experience optimizing network performance for scientific computing and supercomputing clusters to solve AI scalability challenges, as distributed training exhibits the same communication patterns that HPC environments have long addressed.

因此，部署生产训练平台的平台管理员必须实现专用网络配置，绕过标准内核网络栈，利用最初为 HPC 负载开发的高性能互连技术。行业现在直接把数十年为科学计算与超算集群优化网络性能的经验用于解决 AI 扩展性挑战，因为分布式训练呈现出 HPC 环境早已应对的相同通信模式。

While most of the book focuses on software-level configuration and tools to enable LLM workloads, this section describes the hardware options that must be considered during cluster node setup.

本书大部分聚焦软件级配置与工具以支持 LLM 负载，本节则描述集群节点搭建时必须考虑的硬件选项。

NVLink and AMD Infinity Fabric

High-speed point-to-point GPU-to-GPU interconnects provide the highest-bandwidth, lowest-latency communication for direct GPU connections, bypassing Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe) limitations that constrain traditional GPU communication.

高速点对点 GPU 互连为直连 GPU 提供最高带宽、最低延迟通信，绕过限制传统 GPU 通信的 PCIe（PCI Express）约束。

原书第 276 页

NVLink is NVIDIA's proprietary high-speed interconnect that creates direct GPU-to-GPU and GPU-to-CPU communication channels through point-to-point links. Modern NVIDIA data center GPUs like H100 support NVLink 4.0, delivering 900 GBps aggregate bidirectional bandwidth per GPU through 18 high-speed links, enabling gradient synchronization operations to complete in microseconds rather than milliseconds. NVLink is typically deployed in two to four GPU configurations where direct point-to-point connections between GPUs provide optimal performance for smaller-scale training workloads.

NVLink 是 NVIDIA 专用高速互连，通过点对点链路创建直接的 GPU 间与 GPU-CPU 通信通道。H100 等现代 NVIDIA 数据中心 GPU 支持 NVLink 4.0，通过 18 条高速链路提供每 GPU 900 GBps 聚合双向带宽，使梯度同步操作在微秒而非毫秒内完成。NVLink 通常部署在 2–4 GPU 配置中——GPU 间点对点直连为较小规模训练负载提供最优性能。

AMD Infinity Fabric serves as AMD's equivalent interconnect technology for their Instinct MI-Series GPUs (MI250X, MI300X). Infinity Fabric provides high-bandwidth GPU-to-GPU and GPU-to-CPU communication with comparable performance characteristics to NVLink, supporting approximately 900 GBps bidirectional bandwidth in 8-GPU MI300X platform configurations. Similar to NVIDIA's approach, AMD's architecture enables direct memory access between GPUs through point-to-point links optimized for small-scale multi-GPU servers.

AMD Infinity Fabric 是 AMD 为其 Instinct MI 系列 GPU（MI250X、MI300X）提供的对等互连技术。Infinity Fabric 提供与 NVLink 性能相当的高带宽 GPU 间与 GPU-CPU 通信，在 8 GPU MI300X 平台配置中支持约 900 GBps 双向带宽。与 NVIDIA 类似，AMD 架构通过为小规模多 GPU 服务器优化的点对点链路实现 GPU 间直接内存访问。

Both NVLink and Infinity Fabric connectivity are limited to specific server configurations because GPUs must be physically connected through proprietary cables or installed in servers with integrated backplanes, making them primarily intra-node communication technologies for direct GPU-to-GPU links. Notable exceptions include NVIDIA's DGX SuperPOD architectures and AMD's Open Accelerator Module (OAM)-based systems that use these interconnects for small-scale multinode training.

NVLink 与 Infinity Fabric 连接都限于特定服务器配置，因为 GPU 必须通过专用电缆物理连接或安装在带集成背板的服务器上，使其主要成为节点内 GPU 直连通信技术。 notable 例外包括 NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD 架构和 AMD 基于开放加速模块（OAM）的系统——它们把这些互连用于小规模多节点训练。

NVSwitch

For larger GPU configurations requiring full mesh connectivity across eight or more GPUs within a single server, switching fabrics like NVIDIA NVSwitch extend beyond point-to-point links to create nonblocking communication paths between all GPUs simultaneously.

对于需要单服务器内 8 块或更多 GPU 全互联的更大 GPU 配置，NVIDIA NVSwitch 等交换 fabric 超越点对点链路，同时在所有 GPU 之间创建无阻塞通信路径。

原书第 277 页

NVSwitch technology serves as the switching infrastructure that enables full mesh GPU-to-GPU connectivity within servers containing 8 to 16 GPUs, with each GPU achieving up to 900 GBps aggregate bandwidth to the switch fabric. Unlike point-to-point NVLink connections that directly connect pairs of GPUs, NVSwitch acts as a centralized switching fabric where NVLink serves as the physical link technology connecting each GPU to the switch, and the switch provides nonblocking paths between any GPU pair.

NVSwitch 技术作为交换基础设施，在含 8–16 块 GPU 的服务器内实现全互联 GPU 连接，每块 GPU 到交换 fabric 聚合带宽高达 900 GBps。与直接连接 GPU 对的点对点 NVLink 不同，NVSwitch 充当集中交换 fabric——NVLink 是把每块 GPU 连到交换机的物理链路技术，交换机则在任意 GPU 对之间提供无阻塞路径。

This architecture appears in NVIDIA DGX systems and other high-end AI training servers, where NVSwitch enables all-to-all communication patterns required by large-scale distributed training jobs that need to synchronize gradients across many GPUs simultaneously without communication bottlenecks. The full mesh topology ensures that collective operations like all-reduce and all-gather can execute with consistent bandwidth regardless of which GPUs participate in the communication, eliminating the hot-spot contention that would occur if multiple GPUs attempted to communicate through a single point-to-point link.

这种架构出现在 NVIDIA DGX 系统及其他高端 AI 训练服务器中——NVSwitch 提供大规模分布式训练作业所需的全对全通信模式，让众多 GPU 同时同步梯度而无通信瓶颈。全互联拓扑确保 all-reduce、all-gather 等集合操作以一致带宽执行，无论哪些 GPU 参与通信，消除多块 GPU 试图通过单条点对点链路通信时会出现的热点争用。

InfiniBand

InfiniBand represents the gold standard for multinode GPU communication in high-performance computing and large-scale AI training environments, providing Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) capabilities with submicrosecond latency and bandwidth scaling to 400 GBps per port.

InfiniBand 是高性能计算与大规模 AI 训练环境中多节点 GPU 通信的黄金标准，提供远程直接内存访问（RDMA）能力，亚微秒延迟，每端口带宽扩展到 400 GBps。

原书第 278 页

InfiniBand is a dedicated high-speed network fabric originally designed for HPC clusters that allows GPUs and CPUs to directly read and write memory on remote nodes without involving the operating system kernel, eliminating context switches and buffer copies that plague TCP/IP networking.

InfiniBand 是最初为 HPC 集群设计的专用高速网络 fabric，允许 GPU 和 CPU 直接读写远程节点上的内存而不涉及操作系统内核，消除困扰 TCP/IP 网络的上下文切换与缓冲区拷贝。

InfiniBand fabrics scale to thousands of nodes through InfiniBand switches that provide full bisection bandwidth, ensuring that communication between any pair of nodes achieves full line rate regardless of network topology. This is critical for large training jobs where all-reduce operations must aggregate gradients across dozens or hundreds of GPUs simultaneously. However, InfiniBand requires dedicated network infrastructure separate from standard Ethernet data center networks, increasing capital costs and operational complexity. This makes it most appropriate for organizations running large-scale training platforms where the performance benefits justify the infrastructure investment.

InfiniBand fabric 通过提供全对等带宽的 InfiniBand 交换机扩展到数千节点，确保任意节点对之间的通信无论网络拓扑如何都达到全线速。这对大型训练作业至关重要——all-reduce 操作必须同时聚合数十或数百 GPU 的梯度。然而 InfiniBand 需要与标准以太网数据中心网络分离的专用网络基础设施，增加资本成本与运维复杂度。这使它最适合运行大规模训练平台、性能收益足以证明基础设施投资合理的组织。

RoCE

RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE) brings RDMA capabilities to standard Ethernet networks, providing a compromise between InfiniBand's performance and Ethernet's ubiquity and cost-effectiveness. RoCE implements the same RDMA programming interface as InfiniBand but places RDMA packets over Ethernet frames, allowing organizations to leverage existing Ethernet switching infrastructure while still achieving the kernel-bypass and zero-copy benefits of RDMA communication.

融合以太网上的 RDMA（RoCE）把 RDMA 能力带到标准以太网，在 InfiniBand 性能与以太网普及性/成本效益之间提供折中。RoCE 实现与 InfiniBand 相同的 RDMA 编程接口，但把 RDMA 报文放在以太网帧上，让组织能利用现有以太网交换基础设施，同时仍获得 RDMA 通信的内核旁路与零拷贝收益。

RoCEv2 (the current standard as of early 2026) encapsulates RDMA traffic in UDP/IP packets, providing routing capabilities that InfiniBand's Layer 2 communication lacks, though this introduces slightly higher latency compared to native InfiniBand.

RoCEv2（截至 2026 年初的当前标准）把 RDMA 流量封装在 UDP/IP 报文中，提供 InfiniBand 二层通信所缺乏的路由能力，但与原生 InfiniBand 相比延迟略高。

Modern Ethernet adapters supporting RoCE deliver 100 to 400 GBps of bandwidth per port with latencies in the low microsecond range, approaching InfiniBand performance for many workloads while operating over converged networks that also carry standard TCP/IP traffic.

支持 RoCE 的现代以太网适配器每端口提供 100–400 GBps 带宽，延迟在低微秒范围，在许多负载上接近 InfiniBand 性能，同时运行在也承载标准 TCP/IP 流量的融合网络上。

Given the usage of UDP/IP to avoid TCP/IP overhead, it is possible that a packet might get lost, triggering expensive ad hoc retransmissions managed at the application level. The mitigation of this issue requires the adoption of Ethernet configurations that prevent packet loss (like Priority Flow Control and Enhanced Transmission Selection).

由于使用 UDP/IP 避免 TCP/IP 开销，报文可能丢失，触发应用层管理的昂贵临时重传。缓解此问题需要采用防止丢包的以太网配置（如优先级流控 PFC 与增强传输选择 ETS）。

原书第 279 页

Standard Ethernet

Ethernet with TCP/IP networking remains the most accessible option for distributed training, providing adequate performance for smaller-scale jobs or organizations without specialized networking infrastructure.

带 TCP/IP 网络的以太网仍是分布式训练最易获得的选项，为较小规模作业或无专用网络基础设施的组织提供足够性能。

Kubernetes' default networking (via CNI plug-ins like Calico, Cilium, or Flannel) operates over standard Ethernet, delivering 10 GBps to 100 GBps bandwidth, depending on network adapter and switch capabilities, with latencies measured in tens to hundreds of microseconds, depending on network topology and congestion.

Kubernetes 默认网络（通过 Calico、Cilium、Flannel 等 CNI 插件）运行在标准以太网上，根据网卡与交换机能力提供 10–100 GBps 带宽，延迟在数十到数百微秒，取决于网络拓扑与拥塞。

While significantly slower than InfiniBand or RoCE, standard Ethernet remains viable for training jobs at smaller scales. For data-parallel training, standard Ethernet typically suffices for 2–8 nodes when communication overhead remains below 15% of total step time. Practitioners can assess their workload by profiling to measure the ratio of all-reduce time to computation time—exceeding the 20–25% communication overhead signals the need for RDMA-capable networking. The threshold varies based on model size and parallelization strategy: pipeline parallelism generates less network traffic than tensor parallelism, while gradient accumulation can reduce synchronization frequency at the cost of convergence trade-offs.

虽然比 InfiniBand 或 RoCE 慢得多，标准以太网在较小规模训练作业中仍可行。对数据并行训练，当通信开销低于总步时间的 15% 时，标准以太网通常足以支撑 2–8 节点。从业者可通过 profiling 评估负载——测量 all-reduce 时间与计算时间之比；超过 20–25% 通信开销就表明需要 RDMA 网络。阈值随模型大小与并行策略变化：流水线并行产生的网络流量少于张量并行，而梯度累积能降低同步频率，但以收敛性权衡为代价。

The advantage of standard Ethernet lies in its simplicity: no special hardware beyond commodity network adapters, no complex network fabric configuration, and full integration with Kubernetes networking models out of the box.

标准以太网的优势在于简单：除商用网卡外无需特殊硬件，无需复杂网络 fabric 配置，开箱即用地与 Kubernetes 网络模型完全集成。

GPUDirect RDMA

GPUDirect RDMA technology enables direct memory access between GPUs and network adapters, eliminating CPU involvement and memory copies that introduce latency in traditional network communication paths.

GPUDirect RDMA 技术实现 GPU 与网卡之间的直接内存访问，消除传统网络通信路径中引入延迟的 CPU 参与与内存拷贝。

GPU-to-GPU communication is optimized by the previous technologies, but inter-node communication must still go through the kernel and memory copy. GPUDirect RDMA bypasses these intermediate steps by allowing network adapters to directly read from and write to GPU memory without CPU involvement, dramatically improving communication performance for distributed training.

GPU 间通信已由前述技术优化，但节点间通信仍必须经过内核与内存拷贝。GPUDirect RDMA 绕过这些中间步骤，允许网卡直接读写 GPU 内存而不经 CPU，显著提升分布式训练通信性能。

This technology works with both InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, reducing communication latency by 40–60% compared to traditional network paths. However, GPUDirect RDMA requires specific hardware (RDMA-capable network adapters like NVIDIA Mellanox ConnectX), GPU drivers with GPUDirect support enabled, and proper NCCL configuration in training frameworks, making the configuration more complex.

该技术同时适用于 InfiniBand 与 RoCE fabric，相比传统网络路径把通信延迟降低 40–60%。但 GPUDirect RDMA 需要特定硬件（支持 RDMA 的网卡如 NVIDIA Mellanox ConnectX）、启用 GPUDirect 支持的 GPU 驱动，以及训练框架中正确的 NCCL 配置，使配置更复杂。

Making the right choice

原书第 280 页

Figure 7-4 illustrates the complete network stack showing how GPUs connect via NVLink/NVSwitch within nodes and how nodes communicate via InfiniBand, RoCE, or standard Ethernet for multinode training. Platform administrators must balance performance requirements against infrastructure costs and operational complexity when selecting network technologies, with parallelism strategy (see "Model Parallelism" on page 106) being a key consideration in the decision-making process:

图 7-4 展示完整网络栈——GPU 如何在节点内通过 NVLink/NVSwitch 连接，节点之间如何通过 InfiniBand、RoCE 或标准以太网进行多节点训练通信。平台管理员在选择网络技术时必须在性能需求与基础设施成本、运维复杂度之间权衡，并行策略（见第 106 页“模型并行”）是决策过程中的关键考量：

  • For data parallelism workloads — this is the most common strategy for distributed training. Organizations training large models across dozens of nodes should seriously consider InfiniBand with GPUDirect RDMA for its superior bandwidth characteristics that accelerate gradient all-reduce operations, while those with existing high-performance Ethernet infrastructure can leverage RoCE with GPUDirect RDMA to approach InfiniBand performance without wholesale network replacement. For smaller data-parallel training jobs (2–8 nodes), optimizing standard Ethernet configurations with 100 GBps adapters and proper Kubernetes networking provides meaningful improvements without requiring specialized networking expertise.数据并行负载——这是分布式训练最常见的策略。跨数十节点训练大模型的组织应认真考虑 InfiniBand + GPUDirect RDMA，其卓越带宽特性加速梯度 all-reduce；已有高性能以太网基础设施的组织可利用 RoCE + GPUDirect RDMA，在不大规模更换网络的情况下接近 InfiniBand 性能。对较小的数据并行训练作业（2–8 节点），用 100 GBps 网卡与正确的 Kubernetes 网络优化标准以太网配置即可带来显著改进，无需专用网络专长。
  • For tensor parallelism workloads — NVLink and NVSwitch become essential rather than optional, as the latency-sensitive nature of per-layer all-gather and reduce-scatter operations makes these workloads impractical on standard Ethernet and challenging even on InfiniBand for multinode configurations. Tensor parallelism typically remains within a single node (8–16 GPUs with NVSwitch) or in small 2–4 node clusters with InfiniBand, where the submicrosecond latency requirements can be met.张量并行负载——NVLink 与 NVSwitch 从可选变为必需，因为每层 all-gather 与 reduce-scatter 操作对延迟敏感，使这些负载在标准以太网不切实际，在多节点配置中即使在 InfiniBand 上也具挑战。张量并行通常保持在单节点内（NVSwitch 配 8–16 GPU）或用 InfiniBand 的小 2–4 节点集群中，那里能满足亚微秒延迟需求。
  • For pipeline parallelism workloads — the sequential nature of stage-to-stage communication benefits more from topology-aware scheduling that co-locates adjacent pipeline stages (minimizing communication hops) than from raw network bandwidth. RoCE or even optimized Ethernet can suffice for pipeline parallelism, as point-to-point communication between stages represents moderate bandwidth requirements and can tolerate higher latency than tensor parallelism.流水线并行负载——阶段间通信的顺序特性更多受益于把相邻流水线阶段共置的拓扑感知调度（最小化通信跳数），而非原始网络带宽。RoCE 甚至优化的以太网对流水线并行就足够，因为阶段间点对点通信带宽需求中等，比张量并行更能容忍较高延迟。
  • For hybrid parallelism combining multiple strategies — for data + tensor + pipeline, InfiniBand with GPUDirect RDMA becomes the practical choice, as these workloads require both high bandwidth (for data-parallel gradient synchronization) and low latency (for tensor-parallel layer communication), with careful topology-aware scheduling for group tensor-parallel GPUs on NVSwitch domains and data-parallel replicas across InfiniBand fabric.组合多策略的混合并行——数据+张量+流水线时，InfiniBand + GPUDirect RDMA 成为务实选择，因为这些负载同时需要高带宽（数据并行梯度同步）与低延迟（张量并行层间通信），并需仔细的拓扑感知调度：把张量并行 GPU 组放在 NVSwitch 域上，数据并行副本跨 InfiniBand fabric。

Regardless of which network technology you choose (InfiniBand, RoCE, or optimized Ethernet), implementing these high-performance fabrics in Kubernetes requires configuring secondary network interfaces beyond the cluster's standard Container Network Interface (CNI) networking.

无论选择哪种网络技术（InfiniBand、RoCE 还是优化以太网），在 Kubernetes 中实现这些高性能 fabric 都需要在集群标准容器网络接口（CNI）网络之外配置次级网络接口。

Using Secondary Network Interfaces in Kubernetes

Kubernetes originally designed its networking around a single network interface per pod, providing connectivity through the cluster's CNI plug-in, but distributed training workloads require dedicated additional network interfaces and specialized fabrics like InfiniBand or RoCE.

Kubernetes 最初围绕每个 Pod 单个网络接口设计网络，通过集群 CNI 插件提供连接，但分布式训练负载需要专用的额外网络接口与 InfiniBand 或 RoCE 等专用 fabric。

Multus CNI addresses this limitation by enabling pods to attach multiple network interfaces simultaneously so that the primary interface continues to use the cluster's standard CNI, while secondary interfaces provide dedicated paths for training framework communication over specialized networks.

Multus CNI 通过允许 Pod 同时挂载多个网络接口来解决这一限制——主接口继续使用集群标准 CNI，次级接口为训练框架在专用网络上的通信提供专用路径。

Sidebar: Container Network Interface (CNI)

CNI is a Cloud Native Computing Foundation specification that defines a standardized interface between container runtimes and network plug-ins for configuring network interfaces in Linux containers. CNI plug-ins implement the Kubernetes network model by providing pod-to-pod and pod-to-external communication, with each plug-in responsible for creating network interfaces, assigning IP addresses, and establishing connectivity according to cluster networking requirements. The pluggable architecture allows Kubernetes clusters to use different CNI implementations, such as Calico, Cilium, or Flannel, each providing the same core networking functionality while potentially offering additional features like network policies, encryption, or optimized data paths for specific use cases.

CNI 是云原生计算基金会的规范，定义容器运行时与网络插件之间的标准化接口，用于在 Linux 容器中配置网络接口。CNI 插件通过提供 Pod 间与 Pod 到外部的通信来实现 Kubernetes 网络模型，每个插件负责创建网络接口、分配 IP 地址、按集群网络需求建立连接。可插拔架构允许 Kubernetes 集群使用不同 CNI 实现（如 Calico、Cilium、Flannel），各自提供相同核心网络功能，同时可能提供网络策略、加密或针对特定用例优化数据路径等额外特性。
原书第 282 页

Multus CNI operates as a meta-plug-in that delegates network interface creation to other CNI plug-ins based on NetworkAttachmentDefinition (NAD) custom resources that specify how secondary interfaces should be configured.

Multus CNI 作为元插件运行，根据 NetworkAttachmentDefinition（NAD）自定义资源把网络接口创建委托给其他 CNI 插件——NAD 指定次级接口应如何配置。

For example, in the case of InfiniBand, the NAD configures secondary interfaces attached to the ib0 InfiniBand device on each node, assigning IP addresses and enabling direct RDMA access via the rdmaIsolation: false setting for scenarios like GPUDirect (see Example 7-10).

例如 InfiniBand 场景中，NAD 配置挂载到每个节点 ib0 InfiniBand 设备的次级接口，分配 IP 地址，并通过 rdmaIsolation: false 设置为 GPUDirect 等场景启用直接 RDMA 访问（见例 7-10）。

Example 7-10. NetworkAttachmentDefinition configuration of IP over InfiniBand (IPoIB) interfaces

apiVersion: k8s.cni.cncf.io/v1
kind: NetworkAttachmentDefinition
metadata:
  name: ib-network
spec:
  config: '{
    "cniVersion": "0.3.1",
    "type": "ipam",
    "master": "ib0",
    "ipam": {
      "type": "whereabouts",
      "range": "10.0.0.0/24",
      "exclude": [ "10.0.0.1/32" ]
    }
  }'
  • 使用 ipam 插件处理 IP 地址。
  • 使用 whereabouts 插件做 IPAM。

Platform administrators deploy Multus as a DaemonSet across all nodes, then create NAD resources describing the secondary networks available for pod attachment, for example, an InfiniBand network using the IPoIB CNI plug-in. When training pods request secondary network attachments through the k8s.v1.cni.cncf.io/networks annotation, Multus creates and configures the additional network interfaces inside the pod namespace according to the corresponding NAD specifications.

平台管理员把 Multus 作为 DaemonSet 部署到所有节点，然后创建 NAD 资源描述可供 Pod 挂载的次级网络（例如使用 IPoIB CNI 插件的 InfiniBand 网络）。当训练 Pod 通过 k8s.v1.cni.cncf.io/networks 注解请求次级网络挂载时，Multus 按对应 NAD 规范在 Pod 命名空间内创建并配置额外网络接口。

原书第 283 页

In the case of RDMA, it requires a network interface that supports it, and the configuration is more complex because the training frameworks must access RDMA devices (typically exposed as /dev/infiniband/ device files) that provide kernel-bypass communication. A specialized RDMA CNI plug-in works together with Multus to configure RDMA device permissions and ensure that pods can access the appropriate RDMA devices corresponding to their attached network interfaces. Finally, the RDMA device plug-in makes the RDMA interface visible as a resource to the Kubernetes scheduler, making it possible to explicitly request it in the resources part of the deployment spec, for example, using rdma/hca: 1 to request one RDMA host channel adapter.

RDMA 场景需要支持它的网络接口，配置也更复杂——训练框架必须访问提供内核旁路通信的 RDMA 设备（通常暴露为 /dev/infiniband/ 设备文件）。专用 RDMA CNI 插件与 Multus 协作配置 RDMA 设备权限，确保 Pod 能访问与其挂载网络接口对应的 RDMA 设备。最后，RDMA 设备插件把 RDMA 接口作为资源暴露给 Kubernetes 调度器，使 deployment 规范的 resources 部分能显式请求它——例如用 rdma/hca: 1 请求一个 RDMA 主机通道适配器。

Even if the Kubernetes cluster configuration is properly done, it is still necessary to ensure that training framework communication libraries (primarily NCCL, used by NVIDIA for PyTorch workloads) discover and utilize the high-performance network interfaces rather than default to the primary Kubernetes network.

即使 Kubernetes 集群配置正确，仍需确保训练框架通信库（主要是 NVIDIA 为 PyTorch 负载使用的 NCCL）发现并利用高性能网络接口，而非默认走主 Kubernetes 网络。

NCCL automatically detects network interfaces and selects those with RDMA capabilities when available, but it is also possible to explicitly configure it through environment variables, like NCCL_IB_HCA, NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME, and NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL, to provide a deterministic control over which network paths NCCL uses for collective operations (see Example 7-11).

NCCL 自动检测网络接口并在可用时选择支持 RDMA 的接口，但也可以通过 NCCL_IB_HCA、NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME、NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL 等环境变量显式配置，对 NCCL 用于集合操作的网络路径提供确定性控制（见例 7-11）。

It is important that platform administrators coordinate network interface naming to enforce that secondary interfaces have consistent, predictable names across all nodes. This enables training job configurations to specify the correct interface without requiring per-node customization.

平台管理员必须协调网络接口命名，强制次级接口在所有节点上具有一致、可预测的名称。这让训练作业配置能指定正确接口，而无需逐节点定制。

Example 7-11. PyTorchJob configuration with a secondary network

# For TrainJob, configure these settings in the ClusterTrainingRuntime template
apiVersion: kubeflow.org/v1
kind: PyTorchJob
metadata:
  name: llm-training-ib
spec:
  pytorchReplicaSpecs:
    master:
      ...
      template:
        metadata:
          annotations:
            k8s.v1.cni.cncf.io/networks: ib-network
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: pytorch
            ...
            env:
            # Enable this option to get detailed information about
            # detected network interfaces and more
            - name: NCCL_DEBUG
              value: "INFO"
            # Specifies which InfiniBand adapters NCCL should use
            - name: NCCL_IB_HCA
              value: "mlx5_0,mlx5_1"
            # Selects the Global Identifier (GID) index for
            # InfiniBand communication (3=RoCEv2 mode on Ethernet)
            - name: NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX
              value: "3"
            # Enables maximum GPUDirect RDMA optimization
            # allowing direct GPU-to-NIC transfers
            - name: NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL
              value: "5"
            # Directs NCCL to use the secondary network interface
            # for communication instead of the default eth0
            - name: NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME
              value: "net1"
            resources:
              requests:
                ...
                # Require two RDMA host channel adapters per pod
                rdma/hca: 2
              ...
            securityContext:
              capabilities:
                add: ["IPC_LOCK"]
    ...
原书第 284 页
  • 此注解指示 Multus 挂载由 ib-network NAD 定义的次级网络。
  • IPC_LOCK 能力允许容器锁定内存页、防止被换出到磁盘。这对需要 pinned 内存缓冲区的 RDMA 通信至关重要。

Beyond basic configuration, several optimizations and troubleshooting techniques can significantly improve secondary network performance for distributed training (see the following sidebar).

除基础配置外，若干优化与排错技术可显著提升分布式训练的次级网络性能（见下面边栏）。

Sidebar: Secondary Network Optimization and Troubleshooting

Beyond basic secondary network configuration, several optimizations improve network performance for distributed training workloads: NCCL topology awareness — configure NCCL_TOPO_FILE to provide the NVIDIA Collective Communication Library (NCCL) with detailed information about GPU and network adapter topology, enabling optimal communication path selection. NCCL's auto-detection works well for standard configurations but may not discover the fastest paths in complex multi-GPU, multi-NIC servers. Generate topology files using nvidia-smi topo -m on each node, and make them available to training pods through ConfigMaps. Network adapter tuning — modern RDMA adapters expose numerous tuning parameters that impact performance. For Mellanox ConnectX adapters, consider enabling adaptive routing (--set_adaptive_routing in the subnet manager) to balance load across multiple paths in the InfiniBand fabric, and configure appropriate MTU sizes (typically 4,096 for InfiniBand) to reduce packet overhead. NUMA awareness — on multisocket nodes, ensure that training pods are pinned to CPUs local to the GPUs and the network adapters they use, minimizing cross-socket memory traffic that introduces latency. The Kubernetes Topology Manager enables NUMA-aware pod scheduling, and NCCL respects CPU affinity when determining communication patterns. Network isolation — deploy training workloads on dedicated VLANs or InfiniBand partitions isolated from other cluster traffic to prevent congestion from unrelated workloads that could introduce latency variation and degrade training performance. Kubernetes NetworkPolicies provide application-layer isolation, but physical network segregation ensures that high-bandwidth training communication receives guaranteed bandwidth. Verification and troubleshooting — the configuration of the secondary network is not trivial, so it is useful to verify that NCCL detects and uses the expected configuration. See Example 7-12. Platform administrators should benchmark training performance with and without optimized networking to quantify improvements. Realistic benchmarks using representative model architectures and distributed training configurations provide actionable data for infrastructure investment decisions, demonstrating whether the additional complexity of secondary networks and RDMA configuration delivers sufficient performance gains to justify operational overhead.

除基础次级网络配置外，若干优化可改善分布式训练负载的网络性能：NCCL 拓扑感知——配置 NCCL_TOPO_FILE 向 NCCL 提供 GPU 与网卡拓扑的详细信息，以选择最优通信路径。NCCL 自动探测在标准配置下工作良好，但在复杂多 GPU、多网卡服务器上可能找不到最快路径。在每个节点用 nvidia-smi topo -m 生成拓扑文件，通过 ConfigMap 提供给训练 Pod。网卡调优——现代 RDMA 网卡暴露大量影响性能的调优参数。对 Mellanox ConnectX 网卡，考虑在子网管理器中启用自适应路由（--set_adaptive_routing）以在 InfiniBand fabric 的多路径间均衡负载，并配置合适 MTU（InfiniBand 通常 4096）以降低报文开销。NUMA 感知——在多插槽节点上，确保训练 Pod 绑到与所用 GPU 和网卡同 NUMA 本地的 CPU，最小化引入延迟的跨插槽内存流量。Kubernetes Topology Manager 启用 NUMA 感知 Pod 调度，NCCL 在决定通信模式时尊重 CPU 亲和。网络隔离——把训练负载部署在专用 VLAN 或 InfiniBand 分区上，与其他集群流量隔离，防止不相关负载造成拥塞、引入延迟波动、降低训练性能。Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 提供应用层隔离，但物理网络隔离确保高带宽训练通信获得有保障带宽。验证与排错——次级网络配置并不简单，应验证 NCCL 探测并使用了预期配置（见例 7-12）。平台管理员应对比有无优化网络时的训练性能以量化改进。用有代表性的模型架构与分布式训练配置做真实基准测试，为基础设施投资决策提供可执行数据，证明次级网络与 RDMA 配置的额外复杂度是否带来足够性能收益以 justify 运维开销。
原书第 285 页

Example 7-12. Troubleshooting commands for secondary network

# Check that a secondary network interface was created on the primary node
kubectl exec -n %NAMESPACE% llm-training-ib-master-0 -- ip addr show net1

# Verify RDMA devices are accessible
kubectl exec -n %NAMESPACE% llm-training-ib-master-0 -- ls /dev/infiniband/

# Examine NCCL debug output to confirm InfiniBand usage
# "Using network IB" and "NET/IB/GDRDMA" indicates usage of InfiniBand
# with GPUDirect RDMA
kubectl logs -n %NAMESPACE% llm-training-ib-master-0 | grep "NCCL INFO"

Bridging HPC and Kubernetes: Slurm and Slinky

While Kubernetes has emerged as the dominant platform for cloud-native workloads, traditional High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments have decades of refinement in managing large-scale scientific and computational workloads through specialized workload managers like Slurm (Simple Linux Utility for Resource Management). As AI training workloads increasingly resemble HPC batch jobs (requiring gang scheduling, multinode coordination, GPU resource management, and topology-aware placement), there is growing interest in leveraging HPC scheduling expertise within Kubernetes environments.

虽然 Kubernetes 已成为云原生负载的主导平台，但传统高性能计算（HPC）环境通过 Slurm（Simple Linux Utility for Resource Management）等专用负载管理器，在管理大规模科学与计算负载上已有数十年积累。随着 AI 训练负载越来越像 HPC 批作业（需要族群调度、多节点协调、GPU 资源管理、拓扑感知布局），人们越来越有兴趣在 Kubernetes 环境中利用 HPC 调度专长。

Slurm dominates HPC environments worldwide, managing compute resources at the world's largest supercomputing centers with mature capabilities that Kubernetes is only beginning to address: native gang scheduling ensuring all-or-nothing resource allocation, network topology-aware scheduling placing jobs on nodes with optimal GPU interconnect bandwidth, sophisticated accounting systems tracking GPU-hours for charge-back and fairshare policies, and plug-in architectures supporting complex resource selection strategies. The HPC community's expertise with Slurm for managing the largest AI model training workloads provides valuable lessons for Kubernetes-based training platforms.

Slurm 主导全球 HPC 环境，在世界最大超算中心管理计算资源，具备 Kubernetes 才刚开始应对的成熟能力：原生族群调度确保全有或全无资源分配、网络拓扑感知调度把作业放到 GPU 互连带宽最优的节点、跟踪 GPU 小时数以做分摊计费与公平共享策略的复杂记账系统，以及支持复杂资源选择策略的插件架构。HPC 社区用 Slurm 管理最大规模 AI 模型训练负载的经验，为基于 Kubernetes 的训练平台提供宝贵借鉴。

Slinky is SchedMD's innovative suite of projects designed to bridge Slurm and Kubernetes ecosystems, enabling organizations to run Slurm-managed workloads within Kubernetes infrastructure or leverage Slurm's scheduling capabilities alongside Kubernetes orchestration. Slinky provides a Slurm Operator managing Slurm clusters as Kubernetes custom resources with dynamic scaling, a REST Client for integrating Slurm with Kubernetes controllers and webhooks, and a Prometheus Exporter for unified monitoring across both platforms. Organizations with existing HPC infrastructure or workloads requiring Slurm's advanced scheduling features (complex GPU topology requirements, proven fair-share policies, and detailed accounting) may find that Slinky provides a pragmatic migration path, while cloud-native teams should recognize that Kubernetes is actively adopting these HPC patterns through gang scheduling plug-ins, GPU device plug-ins, and topology-aware scheduling proposals.

Slinky 是 SchedMD 创新的项目套件，旨在桥接 Slurm 与 Kubernetes 生态，让组织能在 Kubernetes 基础设施内运行 Slurm 管理的负载，或在 Kubernetes 编排旁利用 Slurm 调度能力。Slinky 提供把 Slurm 集群作为 Kubernetes 自定义资源管理并动态扩缩的 Slurm Operator、用于把 Slurm 与 Kubernetes 控制器和 webhook 集成的 REST Client，以及跨两平台统一监控的 Prometheus Exporter。已有 HPC 基础设施或负载需要 Slurm 高级调度特性（复杂 GPU 拓扑需求、成熟公平共享策略、详细记账）的组织，可能发现 Slinky 提供了务实的迁移路径；而云原生团队应认识到 Kubernetes 正通过族群调度插件、GPU 设备插件、拓扑感知调度提案积极采纳这些 HPC 模式。

原书第 286 页

The convergence of HPC and Kubernetes represents the evolution of AI training infrastructure, with each ecosystem learning from the other's strengths.

HPC 与 Kubernetes 的融合代表 AI 训练基础设施的演进，两个生态互相学习对方长处。

With scheduling, topology awareness, quota management, and high-performance networking configured, the training platform infrastructure requires reliable storage systems to support the complete training job lifecycle, particularly for checkpoint management and recovery from preemption.

配置好调度、拓扑感知、配额管理与高性能网络后，训练平台基础设施还需要可靠存储系统来支持完整训练作业生命周期，尤其是检查点管理与从抢占中恢复。

Storage for Training
训练存储

Reliable persistent storage is critical for distributed training workloads, particularly in GPU as a Service environments where quota management and preemption policies enable dynamic resource sharing. When implementing features like resource borrowing and priority-based preemption ("Quota Management and Multitenancy: GPU as a Service" on page 229), lower-priority training jobs may be paused mid-execution to reclaim GPUs for higher-priority workloads, then resumed later when resources become available. Without robust checkpoint storage, preempted jobs would lose all training progress, forcing expensive recomputation.

可靠持久存储对分布式训练负载至关重要，尤其是在 GPU 即服务环境中——配额管理与抢占策略支持动态资源共享。当实现资源借用与基于优先级的抢占（见第 229 页）时，低优先级训练作业可能在执行中途被暂停以收回 GPU 给高优先级负载，之后资源可用时再恢复。没有健壮的检查点存储，被抢占的作业会丢失全部训练进展，被迫昂贵地重算。

Platform administrators must therefore provision storage infrastructure that supports frequent checkpoint operations, enables recovery from preemption or failures, and provides shared access to training datasets across multiple concurrent jobs.

因此平台管理员必须配置支持频繁检查点操作、能从抢占或故障中恢复、并为多个并发作业提供训练数据集共享访问的存储基础设施。

Several storage technologies address the requirements of distributed training workloads, each with distinct trade-offs in performance, scalability, and operational complexity. Table 7-6 describes the main options.

有多种存储技术应对分布式训练负载需求，每种在性能、可扩展性与运维复杂度上各有取舍。表 7-6 描述主要选项。

SolutionAccess modesPerformance characteristicsOperational complexityBest suited for
Network File Systems (NFS)网络文件系统（NFS）RWX, RWO, ROXRWX/RWO/ROXGood sequential read, degrades under high concurrency or random I/O顺序读良好，高并发或随机 I/O 下退化Low (integrates with existing enterprise NFS infrastructure)低（与现有企业 NFS 基础设施集成）Shared datasets and checkpoints in on-premises deployments with existing NFS已有 NFS 的本地部署中的共享数据集与检查点

A production storage architecture usually combines multiple solutions: object storage for large immutable datasets with streaming APIs, distributed filesystems or cloud managed storage for shared checkpoints requiring ReadWriteMany (RWX) access across distributed workers, and optionally, local NVMe for staging datasets to maximize GPU utilization.

生产存储架构通常组合多种方案：对象存储用于大型不可变数据集与流式 API；分布式文件系统或云托管存储用于需要跨分布式 worker ReadWriteMany（RWX）访问的共享检查点；可选地用本地 NVMe 暂存数据集以最大化 GPU 利用率。

The critical requirement is RWX-capable storage for checkpoints and model artifacts, enabling multiple worker pods across different nodes to access shared state during distributed training, and supporting job resumption after preemption.

关键需求是检查点与模型制品的 RWX 能力存储，让跨不同节点的多个 worker Pod 在分布式训练期间访问共享状态，并支持抢占后恢复作业。

When provisioning storage for training workloads, platform administrators must size storage capacity to accommodate not just the final model artifacts but also all intermediate checkpoints generated during training. A practical rule of thumb for storage sizing is 2 × base_model_size + checkpoint_overhead, accounting for the base model, intermediate checkpoints (which training frameworks typically save every N steps), and final outputs. For example, training a Llama 3.1 8B model with LoRA adapters and frequent checkpointing typically requires 100 GB of storage, while full fine-tuning of a 70B model may require 500 GB or more, depending on checkpoint frequency and retention policies.

为训练负载配置存储时，平台管理员不仅要为最终模型制品，还要为训练期间产生的所有中间检查点规划容量。一个实用经验法则是 2 × 基础模型大小 + 检查点开销，计入基础模型、中间检查点（训练框架通常每 N 步保存一次）与最终输出。例如，用 LoRA 适配器频繁检查点训练 Llama 3.1 8B 模型通常需要 100 GB 存储，而 70B 模型全参数微调可能需要 500 GB 或更多，取决于检查点频率与保留策略。

With storage infrastructure provisioned to support checkpoint management and recovery, platform administrators must also address security considerations that arise from the performance-focused design of distributed training frameworks, particularly in multitenant environments where different teams share the same GPU cluster.

配置好支持检查点管理与恢复的存储基础设施后，平台管理员还必须应对分布式训练框架性能优先设计带来的安全考量，尤其是在不同团队共享同一 GPU 集群的多租户环境中。

Training Job Security
训练作业安全

Distributed training frameworks like Ray and the PyTorch Distributed module introduce unique security challenges that extend beyond traditional Kubernetes workload security considerations. Understanding the architecture of these frameworks and implementing proper default security configuration is essential for platform administrators deploying multitenant training environments. This is mainly due to the design decision that prioritizes performance over built-in security isolation.

Ray、PyTorch Distributed 模块等分布式训练框架带来超越传统 Kubernetes 负载安全考量的独特安全挑战。部署多租户训练环境的平台管理员必须理解这些框架的架构并实施正确的默认安全配置。这主要源于它们把性能置于内建安全隔离之上的设计决策。

原书第 288 页

These frameworks assume they operate within trusted network environments where the system has already authenticated participants rather than using application-level security mechanisms. This design philosophy suited the original use cases of research or single-tenant environments, but it doesn't represent the traditional production multitenant Kubernetes cluster.

这些框架假定运行在可信网络环境中——系统已对参与者做了认证，而非使用应用级安全机制。这种设计哲学适合最初的研究或单租户环境，但不代表传统生产多租户 Kubernetes 集群。

Both frameworks, Ray and PyTorch, provide limited built-in authentication and authorization, in particular for communication between distributed components. Any process that can establish a network connection to a Ray cluster or PyTorch training job can execute arbitrary code with full application privileges. The frameworks send messages unencrypted by default, accept connections from any network source, and execute workloads without security checks, treating network accessibility as implicit authorization.

Ray 与 PyTorch 两个框架提供的内建认证与授权都很有限，尤其是分布式组件间的通信。任何能与 Ray 集群或 PyTorch 训练作业建立网络连接的进程都能以完整应用权限执行任意代码。这些框架默认发送未加密消息、接受来自任何网络源的连接、不加安全检查就执行负载，把网络可达性视为隐式授权。

Default configurations lack communication encryption, which, together with the cloudpickle-based serialization mechanism (well known to be insecure as it can execute arbitrary Python code), extend the attack surface.

默认配置缺乏通信加密，加上基于 cloudpickle 的序列化机制（众所周知不安全——它能执行任意 Python 代码），扩大了攻击面。

Platform administrators must recognize these security limitations as fundamental design choices prioritizing training performance over isolation guarantees. The frameworks explicitly document that distributed features are "intended for internal communication only" and are "not built for use in untrusted environments." Attempting to retrofit strong security boundaries would introduce performance penalties that negate their core value proposition.

平台管理员必须认识到这些安全限制是把训练性能置于隔离保证之上的根本设计选择。这些框架明确文档说明分布式特性“仅供内部通信使用”、“并非为在不可信环境中使用而构建”。事后加装强安全边界会引入性能惩罚，抵消其核心价值主张。

Therefore, securing distributed training deployments must include infrastructure-level controls. Network isolation through Kubernetes NetworkPolicies becomes the primary security mechanism, creating trusted enclaves where only authorized pods within the same training job can communicate. Optional encryption can be layered through TLS for Ray or encrypted CNI plug-ins for PyTorch, providing defense in depth while accepting performance overhead. Distributed training frameworks must be treated as inherently insecure components that become secure only when wrapped in properly designed infrastructure controls, with security boundaries enforced at the network and namespace level.

因此，保护分布式训练部署必须包含基础设施级控制。通过 Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 做网络隔离成为主要安全机制，创建可信 enclaves——只有同一训练作业内授权的 Pod 才能通信。可选加密可叠加——对 Ray 用 TLS，对 PyTorch 用加密 CNI 插件——提供深度防御，同时接受性能开销。分布式训练框架必须被视为本质不安全的组件，只有被妥善设计的基础设施控制包裹时才安全，安全边界在网络与命名空间级别强制执行。

Security Guidelines for Ray

Ray is a distributed computing framework commonly used for reinforcement learning, hyperparameter tuning, and distributed training workloads. The security model of Ray reflects its performance-first design philosophy: it expects to run in a trusted network environment with trusted code, providing no built-in access controls or code isolation mechanisms. This design principle is applied to the entire ecosystem, making any client with network access to Ray services able to execute arbitrary code via Ray jobs, Ray Client APIs, and Dashboard REST endpoints.

Ray 是一个分布式计算框架，常用于强化学习、超参数调优与分布式训练负载。Ray 的安全模型反映其性能优先的设计哲学：它期望运行在可信网络环境与可信代码中，不提供内建访问控制或代码隔离机制。这一设计原则应用于整个生态系统，使任何有 Ray 服务网络访问权限的客户端都能通过 Ray job、Ray Client API、Dashboard REST 端点执行任意代码。

原书第 289 页

The first action to consider is the enablement of TLS authentication for gRPC channels by following the Ray dedicated guide that describes how to configure TLS as rayStartParams in the RayCluster custom resource, with TLS certificates mounted as Kubernetes secrets. This helps to mitigate the attack surface, but it doesn't replace the need for network isolation.

首要行动是按 Ray 专门指南启用 gRPC 通道的 TLS 认证——在 RayCluster 自定义资源中把 TLS 配置为 rayStartParams，并把 TLS 证书作为 Kubernetes secret 挂载。这有助于缓解攻击面，但不能替代网络隔离的需要。

Platform administrators should deploy each Ray cluster in a dedicated Kubernetes namespace and implement infrastructure-level security controls to safely deploy Ray in production environments. The primary security mechanism is network isolation through Kubernetes NetworkPolicies that create strict boundaries around Ray clusters. A properly configured network policy should deny all ingress traffic to Ray head and worker pods by default, then explicitly allow only necessary communication: worker-to-head communication on Ray's internal ports (6379 for Global Control Service (GCS), 8265 for dashboard, 10001 for Ray client server), pod-to-pod communication within the same Ray cluster for object store access, and carefully controlled access to the Ray Client or Jobs API through authentication proxies (see Example 7-13).

平台管理员应把每个 Ray 集群部署在专用 Kubernetes 命名空间中，并实施基础设施级安全控制以在生产环境安全部署 Ray。主要安全机制是通过 Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 做网络隔离，在 Ray 集群周围创建严格边界。配置正确的网络策略应默认拒绝所有到 Ray head 与 worker Pod 的入站流量，然后显式只允许必要通信：worker 到 head 在 Ray 内部端口上的通信（全局控制服务 GCS 用 6379、dashboard 用 8265、Ray client server 用 10001）、同一 Ray 集群内 Pod 间对象存储访问的通信，以及通过认证代理对 Ray Client 或 Jobs API 的谨慎受控访问（见例 7-13）。

Example 7-13. NetworkPolicy configuration for Ray cluster isolation

# Deny all ingress traffic by default for the Ray namespace
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: ray-default-deny
  namespace: ray-cluster-team-a
spec:
  # Empty selector applies to all pods in the namespace,
  # denying all ingress by default
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
---
# Allow worker-to-head communication on Ray internal ports
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: ray-worker-to-head
  namespace: ray-cluster-team-a
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      # Select Ray head node pods to receive traffic from workers
      ray.io/node-type: head
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          # Allow ingress only from pods with the same cluster label,
          # ensuring isolation between Ray clusters
          ray.io/cluster: ray-cluster-team-a
    ports:
    # Port 6379 for Ray GCS server
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 6379
    # Port 8265 for Ray dashboard
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8265
    # Port 10001 for Ray client server
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 10001
---
# Allow pod-to-pod communication within same Ray cluster
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: ray-intra-cluster
  namespace: ray-cluster-team-a
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      ray.io/cluster: ray-cluster-team-a
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          # Object store requires cluster-internal access
          ray.io/cluster: ray-cluster-team-a
---
# Allow controlled access to Ray Client/Jobs API through auth proxy
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: ray-api-access
  namespace: ray-cluster-team-a
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      ray.io/node-type: head
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    # Only allow access from authentication proxy in a separate namespace
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: auth-proxy-namespace
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: oauth2-proxy
    ports:
    # Dashboard access through authentication proxy only
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8265

Security Guidelines for PyTorch

PyTorch Distributed is the most widely used framework for distributed deep learning, powering large-scale training workloads worldwide. PyTorch's Distributed Data Parallel (DDP) replicates models across processes that synchronize gradients using collective communication backends. NCCL is used for GPU-to-GPU, and Gloo is used for CPU-based communication.

PyTorch Distributed 是最广泛使用的分布式深度学习框架，支撑全球大规模训练负载。PyTorch 的分布式数据并行（DDP）把模型复制到多个进程，用集合通信后端同步梯度。GPU 间用 NCCL，CPU 间通信用 Gloo。

PyTorch's distributed features share Ray's critical security limitation: the security policy explicitly states that distributed features are "intended for internal communication only" and are "not built for use in untrusted environments." The framework provides no built-in authorization, sends messages unencrypted by default, and accepts connections from any network source. Anyone with network access can execute arbitrary code with full privileges. Unlike Ray, PyTorch distributed does not provide built-in TLS encryption, making network-level isolation the only effective security control.

PyTorch 分布式特性与 Ray 有相同的关键安全限制：其安全策略明确说明分布式特性“仅供内部通信使用”、“并非为在不可信环境中使用而构建”。框架不提供内建授权，默认发送未加密消息，接受来自任何网络源的连接。任何有网络访问权限的人都能以完整权限执行任意代码。与 Ray 不同，PyTorch 分布式不提供内建 TLS 加密，使网络级隔离成为唯一有效安全控制。

Securing PyTorch distributed training in Kubernetes requires implementing NetworkPolicies that create network isolation boundaries aligned with the framework's security assumptions. Platform administrators should leverage label selectors to scope NetworkPolicies, for example, using a label like pytorch-job-name=my-training-job to select the pods of the job, thus allowing intra-job communication while blocking external traffic. A well-designed policy should follow the same pattern of the example provided for Ray, denying all ingress traffic by default, then explicitly allowing only required communication: pod-to-pod within the same PyTorchJob (NCCL uses dynamic port ranges requiring all TCP traffic between job pods), and ingress from the Kubeflow Trainer's namespace to the rank-0 worker.

在 Kubernetes 中保护 PyTorch 分布式训练需要实现 NetworkPolicy，创建与框架安全假设一致的网络隔离边界。平台管理员应利用标签选择器限定 NetworkPolicy 范围——例如用 pytorch-job-name=my-training-job 标签选择作业的 Pod，从而允许作业内通信、阻断外部流量。设计良好的策略应遵循为 Ray 提供的示例模式：默认拒绝所有入站流量，然后显式只允许所需通信——同一 PyTorchJob 内 Pod 间通信（NCCL 使用动态端口范围，需要作业 Pod 间所有 TCP 流量），以及从 Kubeflow Trainer 命名空间到 rank-0 worker 的入站。

Observability of Training Jobs
训练作业可观测性

Observability for distributed training jobs on Kubernetes presents unique challenges that extend beyond traditional application monitoring, requiring platform administrators to instrument systems that track training progress, resource utilization, and job health across dozens or hundreds of ephemeral pods executing coordinated workloads.

Kubernetes 上分布式训练作业的可观测性带来超越传统应用监控的独特挑战，要求平台管理员埋点系统来跟踪训练进展、资源利用率、作业健康——跨数十或数百个执行协同负载的临时 Pod。

原书第 292 页

Unlike stateless microservices where monitoring individual instances provides sufficient visibility, distributed training jobs demand correlated observability across all worker pods. A single slow worker can slow down the entire job's progress, GPU utilization on one node may be suboptimal while others run efficiently, or gradient synchronization bottlenecks may only appear when examining communication patterns across the full worker set.

无状态微服务监控单个实例即可获得足够可见性，而分布式训练作业要求跨所有 worker Pod 的关联可观测。单个慢 worker 会拖慢整个作业进展；一个节点上 GPU 利用率可能不佳而其他节点运行高效；梯度同步瓶颈只有在检查整个 worker 集合的通信模式时才会出现。

Furthermore, training jobs execute for extended periods (hours to weeks), making it essential to capture both real-time operational metrics for detecting immediate issues and historical training metrics for analyzing convergence behavior, debugging failed experiments, and optimizing hyperparameters across multiple training runs.

此外，训练作业运行很长时间（数小时到数周），必须同时捕获实时运维指标（检测即时问题）与历史训练指标（分析收敛行为、调试失败实验、跨多次训练运行优化超参数）。

Platform administrators must implement comprehensive observability spanning three dimensions: application-level training metrics that track model performance and convergence, infrastructure metrics that monitor resource utilization (i.e., GPU) and job health, and distributed systems metrics that capture communication patterns and coordination overhead.

平台管理员必须实现跨三个维度的全面可观测：跟踪模型性能与收敛的应用级训练指标；监控资源利用率（如 GPU）与作业健康的基础设施指标；捕获通信模式与协调开销的分布式系统指标。

Metrics Collection for Distributed Training

We already covered in "GPU Usage Monitoring" on page 164 how to track GPU metrics, so this section focuses on the other components:

我们已在第 164 页“GPU 使用监控”中介绍了如何跟踪 GPU 指标，本节聚焦其他组件：

  • Training metrics — training metrics capture the actual model performance and learning progress, providing visibility into whether training runs are converging toward desired accuracy targets or diverging due to hyperparameter misconfiguration. Modern training frameworks integrate with experiment tracking systems that record metrics like training loss, validation loss, accuracy, learning rate schedules, and custom application-specific metrics defined by data scientists. TensorBoard is part of the TensorFlow ecosystem but has emerged as the de facto standard for visualizing training metrics in PyTorch too. It is integrated and trains code logs metrics using torch.utils.tensorboard.SummaryWriter or tf.summary. TensorBoard server instances read these logs to provide web-based dashboards showing metric trends over training steps and epochs. In Kubernetes deployments, TensorBoard typically runs as a separate deployment or pod that mounts the same persistent volume where training jobs write their logs, enabling data scientists to monitor training progress in real-time while jobs execute across distributed worker pods. TensorBoard works within a single run, while comparing metrics across multiple training runs requires other tools like MLflow or Weights & Biases.训练指标——训练指标捕获实际模型性能与学习进展，提供训练是在朝期望精度目标收敛还是因超参数配置错误而发散的可见性。现代训练框架与实验跟踪系统集成，记录训练损失、验证损失、精度、学习率调度以及数据科学家定义的自定义应用指标。TensorBoard 属于 TensorFlow 生态，但也已成为 PyTorch 中可视化训练指标的事实标准。它已被集成，训练代码用 torch.utils.tensorboard.SummaryWriter 或 tf.summary 记录指标。TensorBoard 服务器实例读取这些日志，提供基于 Web 的仪表板展示指标随训练步与 epoch 的趋势。在 Kubernetes 部署中，TensorBoard 通常作为独立 deployment 或 Pod 运行，挂载训练作业写日志的同一持久卷，让数据科学家在作业跨分布式 worker Pod 执行时实时监控训练进展。TensorBoard 在单次运行内工作，跨多次训练运行比较指标则需要 MLflow 或 Weights & Biases 等其他工具。
原书第 293 页
  • Job-level metrics — using Kubeflow Trainer Operator simplifies the tracking of the whole job, monitoring the status of worker pods, replica counts, and updating status conditions like Created, Running, Succeeded, or Failed. Each job is formed by multiple pods that produce traditional metrics that can be exported to Prometheus, and the training job produces Kubernetes Events related to the job lifecycle.作业级指标——使用 Kubeflow Trainer Operator 简化整个作业的跟踪，监控 worker Pod 状态、副本数，并更新 Created、Running、Succeeded、Failed 等状态条件。每个作业由多个 Pod 组成，产生可导出到 Prometheus 的传统指标，训练作业还产生与作业生命周期相关的 Kubernetes Event。

Logging Across Distributed Workers

Logging distributed training jobs introduces complexity because meaningful log analysis requires correlating logs from multiple worker pods that execute in parallel, often generating identical log messages at slightly different timestamps.

记录分布式训练作业日志带来复杂性，因为有意义的日志分析需要关联并行执行的多个 worker Pod 的日志——它们常在略有不同的时间戳生成相同日志消息。

The most straightforward approach uses a centralized logging infrastructure where all pod logs are collected into a searchable log aggregation system like Elasticsearch, Loki, or CloudWatch Logs, with logs tagged by job name, worker rank, and pod name to enable filtering and correlation.

最直接的方式是使用集中式日志基础设施，把所有 Pod 日志收集到 Elasticsearch、Loki 或 CloudWatch Logs 等可搜索的日志聚合系统中，日志按作业名、worker rank、Pod 名打标签以支持过滤与关联。

In PyTorch distributed training, the standard practice is to have only rank-0 emit detailed training logs showing the epoch progress, loss values, and checkpoint operations, while other workers either suppress output entirely or log only error conditions, reducing log volume and avoiding duplicate information. This approach is usually enough to provide good visibility of the internals of the job, but it is not uncommon that debugging distributed training failures requires examining logs from all workers to identify which specific rank encountered errors. That's why a good practice is to always collect logs from all workers and use tools or UI filters to show only rank-0 logs by default.

在 PyTorch 分布式训练中，标准做法是只让 rank-0 输出详细训练日志（展示 epoch 进展、损失值、检查点操作），其他 worker 要么完全抑制输出，要么只记录错误条件，从而减少日志量并避免重复信息。这种方式通常足以提供作业内部的良好可见性，但调试分布式训练失败时往往需要检查所有 worker 的日志以确定具体哪个 rank 遇到错误。因此最佳实践是始终收集所有 worker 日志，默认用工具或 UI 过滤器只显示 rank-0 日志。

At scale, the volume of logs can become the main challenge, because a generic full-text search through the logs of multiple jobs is not a manageable solution. This makes structured logging critical: training code should emit logs in structured (JSON) format with a set of common fields like job_name, worker_rank, step_number, epoch, loss_value, etc. Kubernetes logging frameworks like Fluent Bit or Fluentd can be configured to parse and enrich logs with additional metadata from pod labels and annotations, automatically adding fields for namespace, node name, and GPU device IDs to create comprehensive log records that can be queried.

在规模下，日志量本身会成为主要挑战——对多个作业的日志做通用全文搜索不是可管理的方案。这使结构化日志至关重要：训练代码应以结构化（JSON）格式输出日志，带一组公共字段如 job_name、worker_rank、step_number、epoch、loss_value 等。Fluent Bit 或 Fluentd 等 Kubernetes 日志框架可配置为解析日志并用 Pod 标签与注解中的额外元数据富化，自动添加命名空间、节点名、GPU 设备 ID 字段，创建可查询的全面日志记录。

Tracing Distributed Training Operations

Distributed tracing might be necessary to highlight bottlenecks that are related to coordination or communication patterns.

分布式追踪可能是必要的，以突出与协调或通信模式相关的瓶颈。

原书第 294 页

PyTorch provides built-in profiling capabilities through PyTorch Profiler (torch.profiler), which can instrument training code to capture detailed performance traces, including CPU operations, GPU kernel execution, memory allocations, and crucially for distributed training, collective communication operations like all-reduce and all-gather.

PyTorch 通过 PyTorch Profiler（torch.profiler）提供内建 profiling 能力，可埋点训练代码捕获详细性能 trace，包括 CPU 操作、GPU kernel 执行、内存分配，以及对分布式训练至关重要的 all-reduce、all-gather 等集合通信操作。

Profiler results can be visualized using TensorBoard's profiling plug-in, which provides timeline views showing GPU utilization over time, stack traces identifying performance bottlenecks in training code, and a distributed view showing communication patterns across ranks. This can help data scientists optimize batch sizes, adjust gradient accumulation strategies, or identify network bottlenecks that throttle distributed training throughput.

Profiler 结果可用 TensorBoard 的 profiling 插件可视化，提供展示 GPU 利用率随时间变化的时间线视图、识别训练代码性能瓶颈的栈追踪，以及展示跨 rank 通信模式的分布式视图。这能帮助数据科学家优化 batch 大小、调整梯度累积策略，或识别限制分布式训练吞吐的网络瓶颈。

It is possible to have lower-level performance analysis from the GPU workload itself at the CUDA kernel level using NVIDIA Nsight Systems. However, this level of profiling is typically reserved for specific performance optimization efforts rather than routine monitoring, as trace file sizes can grow to gigabytes for long-running profiling sessions, and the profiling overhead itself impacts training performance.

可以用 NVIDIA Nsight Systems 在 CUDA kernel 级别对 GPU 负载本身做更低层性能分析。但这种 profiling 级别通常保留给特定性能优化工作而非日常监控，因为长时间 profiling 会话的 trace 文件可膨胀到 GB 级，且 profiling 开销本身会影响训练性能。

Lessons Learned
本章小结

In this chapter we explored the operational foundations required to run production-scale AI training workloads on Kubernetes, from scheduling and networking to storage and security.

本章探讨了在 Kubernetes 上运行生产规模 AI 训练负载所需的运维基础——从调度、网络到存储与安全。

原书第 295 页

Operating production-scale AI training platforms requires fundamentally different approaches than traditional stateless application deployments. Network requirements must be considered during cluster provisioning, with choices strictly related to GPU models and interconnect topology.

运营生产规模 AI 训练平台需要与传统无状态应用部署根本不同的方式。网络需求必须在集群配置时就考虑，选择与 GPU 型号和互连拓扑严格相关。

Gang scheduling and topology-aware scheduling become nonnegotiable because the default scheduler's per-pod model creates resource fragmentation when jobs receive partial allocations, wasting expensive GPU resources.

族群调度与拓扑感知调度成为不可妥协的要求，因为默认调度器的逐 Pod 模型在作业获得部分分配时会造成资源碎片，浪费昂贵 GPU 资源。

Security and storage represent operational foundations that cannot be retrofitted after deployment. Storage requires tiered solutions: object storage for datasets, distributed filesystems for shared checkpoints with RWX access enabling job resumption after preemption, and optionally, local NVMe for staging.

安全与存储代表部署后无法事后加装的运维基础。存储需要分层方案：对象存储用于数据集；分布式文件系统用于带 RWX 访问的共享检查点，支持抢占后恢复作业；可选地用本地 NVMe 做暂存。

Platform administrators should treat infrastructure design as product thinking, measuring success by training job success rate and time-to-result rather than infrastructure uptime. The scheduling, security, storage, and observability choices documented in this chapter collectively define the developer experience for data scientists, treating them as customers whose workflow efficiency directly impacts the organization's ability to iterate on model development and deliver AI capabilities to production.

平台管理员应把基础设施设计当作产品思考，用训练作业成功率与出结果时间而非基础设施正常运行时间来衡量成功。本章记录的调度、安全、存储、可观测选择共同定义了数据科学家的开发者体验——把他们视为客户，其工作流效率直接影响组织迭代模型开发、把 AI 能力交付到生产的能力。

原书第 296 页

This concludes Part III. With the infrastructure for tuning in place, you can now customize foundation models and run training workloads at scale. The next part shifts perspective from models to applications: how to build complete AI-driven systems that orchestrate LLMs alongside vector databases, tool invocations, and agentic workflows.

第三部分到此结束。有了微调的基础设施，你现在可以定制基础模型并大规模运行训练负载。下一部分把视角从模型转向应用：如何构建完整的 AI 驱动系统，把 LLM 与向量数据库、工具调用、智能体工作流编排在一起。

Part IV. AI-Driven Apps
第四部分 AI 驱动应用

Having covered how to run LLMs for inference and tuning on Kubernetes, we now shift from serving single models to building complete AI-driven applications. LLM services rarely run in isolation: they're typically integrated within larger systems that orchestrate flows between conversational interfaces, vector databases for context retrieval, and model services for generation.

在介绍了如何在 Kubernetes 上运行 LLM 做推理与微调之后，我们现在从服务单个模型转向构建完整的 AI 驱动应用。LLM 服务很少孤立运行：它们通常集成在更大的系统中，编排对话界面、用于上下文检索的向量数据库、用于生成的模型服务之间的流程。

This part begins with architectural patterns for AI-driven applications, from chat interfaces to event-driven backends, and introduces retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for grounding model outputs in external knowledge and agentic workflows where LLMs coordinate tool invocation and multistep reasoning. Moving from architecture to operations, we address production challenges unique to agentic systems: security, state management, observability, cost control, and reliability, along with protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) that standardize tool and agent communication.

本部分从 AI 驱动应用的架构模式开始——从对话界面到事件驱动后端——并介绍检索增强生成（RAG）以外部知识锚定模型输出，以及 LLM 协调工具调用与多步推理的智能体工作流。从架构走向运维，我们应对智能体系统独有的生产挑战：安全、状态管理、可观测性、成本控制与可靠性，以及标准化工具与智能体通信的模型上下文协议（MCP）与智能体间（A2A）协议。
